多智能体系统

[MA-0] Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决合作式多智能体强化学习（Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）中行为多样性（behavioral diversity）的动态调控问题。在协作任务中，智能体需通过协调行动实现共同目标，而适当的行为多样性有助于形成角色分工与更丰富的联合策略，但其最优水平高度依赖于具体任务场景，且手动调参成本高昂。为此，论文提出自适应多样性控制（Adaptive Diversity Control, ADiCo），其核心在于构建一个双时标反馈控制系统：在快速时标上，通过多样性控制（Diversity Control, DiCo）将系统多样性实时调节至目标值；在慢速时标上，采用极值搜索控制器（Extremum Seeking Controller, ESC）仅基于平均回合回报信号在线调整该目标值，无需显式模型或多样性-性能曲面的解析梯度。实验表明，ADiCo能在不同任务配置下自动维持适配当前需求的多样性水平——在需要同质策略时保持低多样性，在需异质策略时提升多样性，其平均性能优于经过网格搜索优化的DiCo及无约束多样性演化（Unconstrained DiCo）。结果验证了将经典反馈控制机制引入MARL训练流程，可实现高效、自适应的协调机制，为避免任务特异性的人工多样性参数设定提供了系统性解决方案。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18808
作者: Svar Rajankumar Patel,Kshitij Jerath
机构: University of Massachusetts Lowell (马萨诸塞大学洛厄尔分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Robotics (cs.RO); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注: Accepted for publication at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026), Hawaii, USA

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents’ potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

[MA-1] PlanPath: Exploration-Guided Orchestration for Patient-Level Pathology Reasoning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决病理学诊断中跨多个组织切片（Whole Slide Image, WSI）进行患者层面综合分析的难题。传统病理学智能代理通常仅逐张切片进行形态描述，缺乏对多部位、多切片间互补证据的系统性整合与量化分析能力，导致无法实现真正意义上的患者级结论生成。其核心挑战在于如何在海量异质性切片中精准定位相关证据，并实现从组织架构到单个细胞级别的细粒度测量与跨切片量化整合。为此，本文提出PlanPath——一种面向患者级病理视觉问答（Patient-level Pathology VQA）的智能体框架。该方案的关键在于将问题转化为可执行的探索计划（exploration plan），明确所需证据类型，智能路由至潜在相关切片，并驱动“粗粒度至细粒度”的逐步证据采集过程；同时，利用组织与细胞层级的分析工具获取计数、比例及范围等可量化的特征，由PlanPath在不同切片间聚合形成可追溯的答案。为支持评估，研究构建了两个患者级VQA数据集（肾癌和胃癌），每例平均包含15张WSI，且所有问答对均经病理科医生验证，源自真实诊断报告。实验结果表明，PlanPath在两项数据集上的整体准确率分别优于最强基线9.4%和12.1%，且可显著提升现有滑片级代理的性能。该工作推动了病理学人工智能从局部描述向全局量化推理的范式演进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18664
作者: Jiusong Ge,Mingzhao He,Qidong Liu,Chunbao Wang,Chunze Yang,Di Zhang,Jiashuai Liu,Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar,Huazhu Fu,Chen Li,Zeyu Gao
机构: Xi’an Jiaotong University (西安交通大学); University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); A*STAR (新加坡科技研究局); Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences (中国医学科学院)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A patient’s pathology case spans tens of slides from distinct specimens and anatomical sites, each carrying non-redundant, site-specific evidence. Forming a patient-level conclusion therefore requires locating the slides relevant to a given question and integrating complementary findings across them. However, existing pathology agents analyze one slide at a time and describe morphology rather than measure it, leaving evidence acquisition across a patient’s specimens and patient-level quantification underexplored. To address this gap, we propose PlanPath, an agentic framework for patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA). PlanPath turns the question into an exploration plan that specifies the evidence required, routes to the slides likely to carry it, and drives coarse-to-fine acquisition from tissue architecture down to individual cells. Tissue- and cell-level tools supply the counts, proportions, and extents, which PlanPath aggregates across slides into a traceable answer. To enable evaluation, we build two patient-level VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer, averaging 15 WSIs per patient, with pathologist-verified question-answer pairs derived from diagnostic reports. Experimental results show that PlanPath outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.4% and 12.1% in overall accuracy on the two datasets and further improves existing slide-level agents when plugged into our framework. The dataset and code are available at: this https URL.

[MA-2] On Symmetry for Characterizing Agent Heterogeneity in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中智能体异质性（agent heterogeneity）的结构性表征问题，即如何在不依赖特定策略或初始状态分布的前提下，对智能体进行基于结构的类型划分。现有方法缺乏统一的结构判别准则，难以有效区分共享策略与个体特异性策略的适用场景。为此，作者在有限时域部分可观测马尔可夫博弈（finite-horizon POSGs）框架下，提出了“策略评估对称性”（policy-evaluation symmetry）的概念：当任意分布式行为策略下的完整策略评估过程与该变换可交换时，该变换即为策略评估对称性。这些对称性构成一个群，其作用下智能体的轨道（agent orbits）定义了结构化的智能体类型。该分类具有内在不变性，不依赖于具体策略选择或初始状态分布。研究进一步证明，所有分量式环境自同构（componentwise environment automorphism）均属于策略评估对称性，但反之不成立。通过将该框架应用于合作型Dec-POMDPs，发现即使智能体共享相同奖励函数，仍可能属于不同结构类型。针对加权奖励聚合情形，作者推导出精确的值函数恒等式，并给出了源POSG的策略评估对称性可被继承至目标Dec-POMDP的充分条件。最后，文章揭示了重复模型因子分解（repeated model factorizations）可诱导策略评估对称性的充分条件，并指出保持最优Boltzmann策略集既非该对称性的必要条件，也非充分条件。因此，该研究的核心解决方案在于建立一套基于策略评估对称性的、不受策略与初始状态影响的智能体结构分类体系，为设计高效且合理的共享/专属策略表示提供理论基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18538
作者: Jianhong Wang,Jonathan Lawry
机构: INFORMED-AI Hub, University of Bristol (INFORMED-AI中心，布里斯托大学); School of Engineering Mathematics and Technology, University of Bristol (工程数学与技术学院，布里斯托大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 25 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding agent heterogeneity can inform the design of shared and agent-specific policy representations, however existing criteria provide no unified structural test. We study finite-horizon POSGs and define a type-compatible transformation as a policy-evaluation symmetry when complete policy evaluation commutes with it for every decentralized behavioral policy. Policy-evaluation symmetries form a group for which agent orbits define structural agent types. This classification does not depend on the particular policy chosen or the distribution of initial states. We prove that every componentwise environment automorphism is a policy-evaluation symmetry, but that the converse does not hold. Applying the framework to cooperative Dec-POMDPs shows that agents can belong to different structural types even when they share a common reward. For prescribed weighted reward aggregation, we derive an exact value identity and sufficient conditions for the resulting Dec-POMDP to inherit the policy-evaluation symmetries of the source POSG. Finally, we give sufficient conditions under which repeated model factorizations induce policy-evaluation symmetry, and show that preserving an optimal Boltzmann policy set neither implies nor follows from this symmetry in general.

[MA-3] CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多架无人机（UAVs）在风扰、载荷运动及目标广播噪声等复杂环境下，协同空中抓取与操作任务中因共享载荷导致的强耦合动力学问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持控制架构去中心化的同时，实现高精度的位置与姿态跟踪，尤其是在动态目标和外部干扰下的鲁棒性。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为CALM（Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation）的去中心化控制器，融合了参数共享的多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略（基于多智能体近端策略优化，MAPPO），并引入基于每架无人机的扩展状态观测器（ESO）以估计外部扰动与载荷质量，结合目标运动预测的前馈式编队偏航控制，提前调整编队姿态以减少篮筐偏航滞后，且不增加净控制力。此外，采用条件扰动的集中式训练-去中心化执行（CTDE）框架，使策略在训练时利用全局信息优化价值函数，而执行阶段仍保持完全去中心化。实验表明，CALM在未见轨迹上显著优于多种基线方法（包括机械臂基准、缆绳悬挂实现及两种模型基控制器），在位置与姿态误差方面均表现更优，且在全信息路径退化场景下仍具备统计上相当或更优的性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18425
作者: Jiaxi Huo,Petre Ricioppo,Fausto Francesco Lizzio
机构: 未知
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 8 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7 ^\circ ), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at this https URL.

[MA-4] Choosing LLM s for Strategic Agent Interactions FAST NEURIPS

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在动态博弈环境中进行战略选择时面临的挑战，即现有评估框架仅针对固定模型在特定游戏类型和交互结构下的表现进行评价，忽视了对手未知、可自适应演化以及反馈信号随时间变化的复杂性。其核心问题是：如何在存在非平稳性和对抗性对手的条件下，实现对LLM战略能力的有效评估与动态选择。解决方案的关键在于提出一种“元博弈”（meta game）范式，将战略选择建模为在基础博弈之上的高层决策过程。在此框架中，一个策略选择器（strategic selector）从模型组合中动态调用不同LLM，以应对在线学习的隐含收益矩阵。研究发现，评估信号具有显著的游戏特异性，需远高于传统基准设置的种子运行次数（N）才能获得可靠信号。实验表明，依赖查询嵌入或模型自我反思的方法无法稳定捕捉深层战略信号，而轻量级多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandit）算法表现出更强的鲁棒性，但仍不及最优固定模型的表现；更重要的是，简单的非平稳及对抗性老虎机变体未能超越静态基线，揭示了当前方法在处理动态对手时存在的关键缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18354
作者: Arastun Mammadli,Herbert Woisetschläger,Jawad Fayaz,Shiqiang Wang
机构: University of Exeter(埃克塞特大学); IBM Research(IBM 研究院)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: NeurIPS workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST), 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs N compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model’s strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.

[MA-5] Strategic Multi-Agent Resource Allocation via Statistical Contracts

【速读】：该论文旨在解决一类战略性假设检验问题，即当多个拥有与主方目标相关数据或数据生成机制的代理（agent）竞争资源分配时，如何设计一种统计契约（statistical contract），使得主方能够在保证非零假设（non-null）代理参与激励的同时，最小化对零假设（null）代理的资源分配。其核心挑战在于：在代理行为可能具有任意依赖性且存在策略性参与动机的情况下，如何实现对资源配置的严格风险控制和公平性保障。解决方案的关键在于引入e值（e-values）构建“连续闭包”（continuous-closure）——一个能够确保零假设代理在期望上无法获利，并为任意依赖结构下的通用损失函数提供事后风险控制的分配集合。该框架在损失函数为分配给零假设代理的资源比例时，支持多项式时间内的线性优化求解；同时，作者给出了可解释的显式近似形式，并从非零假设代理的视角分析了参与激励条件，明确了其进入契约的盈利边界。此外，研究进一步扩展至在线代理接入场景，提出一种具有时间一致误差控制能力的方法，使主方能在不可逆的实时决策中维持严格统计保障。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18336
作者: Ben Chugg,Michael I. Jordan,Aaditya Ramdas
机构: Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); UC Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); ÉNS (巴黎高等师范学校); Inria (法国国家信息与自动化研究所); Stanford University (斯坦福大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Methodology (stat.ME)
备注: 36 pages, four figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study a class of strategic hypothesis testing problems in which a principal aims to allocate resources among competing agents who possess data or data-generating mechanisms that may be relevant to the principal’s goals. Each agent can pay a participation cost to opt into a statistical contract, in which case they generate data from a private distribution and receive an allocation based on a predetermined (and publicly known) mechanism. Each agent is either “null” or “non-null” and the principal’s goal is to design the contract to limit the allocation to the former while maximizing transactions with the latter. Using e-values, we define a “continuous-closure,” a set of allocations which prevents null agents from profiting in expectation and provides post-hoc risk control for general loss functions under arbitrary dependence. When the loss is the fraction of resources allocated to null agents, the region admits polynomial-time linear optimization. We also give explicit, interpretable closed-form approximations, and we analyze participation from a non-null agent’s perspective, giving conditions under which entry into the contract is profitable. Finally, we extend the framework to support online arrival of the agents, in which case the principal has to make irrevocable on-the-fly decisions, and provide a method which gives time-uniform error-control in this setting.

[MA-6] When Does Opponent Modeling Pay Off? Spatial Inference Stabilises Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability AAMAS2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决部分可观测竞争性博弈中深度强化学习智能体在缺乏对手完整信息情况下如何有效推断对手意图并稳定训练的问题。其核心挑战在于，传统基于时序差分（TD(0)）的DQN在部分可观测环境中容易因信用分配困难而陷入训练退化（degenerate seeds），尤其在多步决策配置中表现不稳定。解决方案的关键在于引入一个空间对手模型（spatial opponent model）——基于回溯重标注（hindsight-relabelled）对手目标训练的Transformer架构，能够从对手观测轨迹中生成子目标热力图（subgoal heatmap），并在早期与主网络融合，嵌入到双延迟Q网络（dueling double DQN）中。该模块通过显式建模对手潜在目标，显著提升了训练稳定性：在对称零和觅食博弈中，采用该模块的智能体从未发生训练崩溃，且在成功训练的情况下可恢复接近理论最优的对称博弈价值。此外，该方法具备零样本迁移能力，能有效应对训练阶段未见过的对手，其性能优于基线模型，但在信息论分析预测的边界条件下（如全信息追踪型对手或资源密集地图）会失去优势。消融实验表明，该方法的优势由两机制构成：一是训练期的稳定性增强，主导于信用分配困难且对“盲视”（blinding）具有鲁棒性的高密度地图；二是部署期的推理能力，其作用随环境透明度提升（雾气变薄）而减弱。最终结论为：对手目标推断是一种受可测量边界条件调控的稳定性和迁移性机制，其有效性取决于可见性（雾厚度）、对手意图及资源密度。

Abstract:Deep reinforcement learning agents in partially observable competitive games must act on beliefs about an unseen opponent’s intent. We study a spatial opponent model: a transformer trained with hindsight-relabelled opponent goals that outputs a subgoal heatmap from the opponent’s observed trajectory, fused early into a dueling double DQN. In symmetric constant-sum foraging games with partial observability, the module stabilises training. Plain TD(0) DQN suffers degenerate seeds in three of four one-step configurations, whereas the opponent-model agent never collapses and, wherever training succeeds, recovers the majority of the symmetric game value. Transfers zero-shot to a foraging opponent unseen by the learner, with a positive goal advantage over the baseline, and loses this edge exactly where an information argument predicts: against a full-information tracking adversary whose intent is the learner itself, and on resource-dense maps where both agents saturate. A blindfold ablation, zeroing the heatmap at deployment, decomposes the advantage into two mechanisms: training-time stabilisation, which dominates where the credit assignment is hard and survives blinding on the dense map, and deployment-time inference, whose reliance shrinks as fog thins on the sparse map. We conclude that opponent-goal inference is a stability-and-transfer mechanism whose value is governed by measurable boundary conditions: visibility (fog thickness), opponent intent, and resource density.

[MA-7] Fan Out or Relay? Ownership-Aware Routing for LLM Agents Querying Siloed Tables

【速读】：该论文旨在解决组织内部数据所有权分散导致的查询执行效率与准确性难题：当一个查询涉及多个数据拥有者时，传统方法如“广播式路由（fan-out）”或“逐级传递路由（relay）”无法在不预先知晓数据所有权的情况下保证最优性能。其核心问题在于，哪种路由策略更优完全取决于数据所有权分布，而非查询结构本身。解决方案的关键在于提出一种所有权感知路由（Ownership-Aware Routing, OAR）机制：OAR通过仅基于模式（schema-only）生成SQL查询，统计涉及的数据拥有者数量，在读取任何私有数据行之前即完成路由决策。该方法利用公开的数据所有权信息，避免了因错误路由导致的信息泄露或精度损失。实验表明，在10个场景中OAR始终不劣于最优固定协议，且在PeopleJoin上显著优于所有固定协议，最高提升达9.3个百分点，验证了其在真实组织环境中的有效性与鲁棒性。

作者: Zhexi Feng
机构: University of California San Diego(加州大学圣地亚哥分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Inside organizations, a question’s data often sit with several owners, who query their own tables but never hand them over. An LLM coordinator can fan out, sending the question to every owner at once, or relay, querying owners in turn and reusing earlier rows. We show that neither is safe in advance, because data ownership decides which one is right. Across thirteen settings on PeopleJoin and BIRD with three model families, fan-out is more accurate in twelve on questions one owner can answer, yet answers at most 4.3% of those joining two owners’ tables. The flip follows ownership, not query shape: on BIRD two-table joins, fan-out answers 32-44% when one owner holds both and 1-4% otherwise. Relay wins by conditioning on returned rows, and hiding them from an otherwise identical planner cuts two-owner accuracy from 23.2% to 5.1%. Since ownership is public, we propose Ownership-Aware Routing (OAR), which drafts a schema-only SQL query, counts the owners whose tables it joins, and routes the question before any private row is read. In ten settings OAR is never significantly less accurate than the best fixed protocol, and beats every fixed protocol on PeopleJoin, by up to 9.3 points on held-out organizations.

[MA-8] Fresh at Decision Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在做出决策时因信息时效性不足而导致的准确性下降问题。由于决策在生成时即被确定，而执行时环境已发生变化，因此模型所依赖的信息可能已过时，从而影响最终行为的有效性。其核心解决方案是提出“决策有效性的时间戳理论”（timestamp theory of decision validity），并构建一个“决策账本”（decision ledger）以实现该理论。该账本通过六个时间戳精确记录每个决策的生成与更新过程，并引入“新鲜度上限”（freshness ceiling）来界定在执行时刻可保证的信息时效性范围，将后续新增信息带来的不确定性风险显式隔离。模型的准确性由此分解为两大能力：一是“路由”（routing），即确保相关最新信息在决策修订截止前送达；二是“时间判断”（temporal judgment），即准确识别信息的时间效力以决定执行时机。实验验证表明，仅凭新鲜度即可实现理论预测的准确率上限，且模型在关键信息到达后立即响应，准确率随路由效率提升而上升；账本索引机制决定了路由覆盖范围，而决策时设定的“监控条件”（watch conditions）可低暴露地捕捉间接依赖关系，剩余误差主要源于变化生效的时间点判定。因此，决策的正确性不仅取决于初始判断，更依赖于对信息流的精准调度与时间维度的精确理解。

类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision’s times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger’s index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

[MA-9] ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体大语言模型（Multi-agent LLM）系统在推理过程中因采用固定协商协议而导致的计算资源分配不合理问题，特别是由此引发的语义虚假共识（semantic false consensus）——即群体答案虽表现自信，但其支持理由存在狭窄、重复或相关性过高，缺乏真正独立验证的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于证据感知的控制器ECMR，该控制器作用于冻结的角色条件化大语言模型（frozen role-conditioned LLMs），在每一步决策中综合评估答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾情况、角色行为模式、验证历史及剩余预算，并据此动态选择“提议”“挑战”“验证”“仲裁”“多样化”“修正角色”或“停止”等动作。该决策过程被形式化为有限时域的带预算控制问题，并推导出状态条件化、风险触发验证及角色修正能提升成本调整后效用的充分条件。实验表明，在MedQA、CaseHOLD和FinQA共9,000条公开测试样本上，ECMR-Full将整体准确率从62.1%提升至84.9%，虚假共识率由40.7%降至17.0%，证据支持率从58.0%提高至88.7%；尽管状态随机化导致准确率下降11.7个百分点且仅减少0.7轮次，而更复杂任务则趋向于延迟终止并转向仲裁机制，说明ECMR-Full虽使用最大令牌预算，但实现了最强的绝对可靠性，而非普遍更高的令牌效率。

作者: Yuan Liu,Haoyue Peng,Fanliang Hu,Lei Huang,Wenli Cai
机构: Medical Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Chongqing University Cancer Hospital; Chongqing University, Chongqing 400030, China
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

[MA-10] Degrees of Freedom in Multi-Agent Coordination: Between Centralized and Decentralized Regimes

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）中集中式协调与去中心化协调之间的权衡问题。集中式协调虽能提供明确控制，但易形成单一瓶颈；而去中心化协调虽具备局部自主性，却需通过分布式决策与经验共享实现有效协作。为系统性探索二者之间的中间协调空间，本文提出“自由度”（Degrees of Freedom, DoF）这一连续配置框架，用于量化下层智能体被委派的决策空间规模。DoF的关键在于调节任务粒度与任务单元分配至各分支的概率，其两端分别对应极端的集中式与去中心化协调模式。实证结果表明，不同任务域对最优DoF配置存在依赖性：多数场景下，中间配置显著优于两端，且在域内保留经验可缩小两类分支间的性能差异。此外，任务领域特性与保留经验对协调模式的影响强于内部路由机制，揭示出任务依赖性的协调性能景观。研究为设计和优化LLM-MAS中的中间协调机制提供了可量化的实证依据。

作者: Yiqing Peng,Hehai Lin,Zixuan Wang,Dongyi Zhang,Zhengjie Zhu,Yi Han,Yangyang Zheng,Hao Wang,Qian Li,Chengwei Qin
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Wake Forest University; Shandong University; University of Science and Technology of China
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are commonly organized around two coordination regimes. Centralized coordination provides explicit control but can create a bottleneck at a single coordination locus, whereas decentralized coordination offers local autonomy but must achieve effective collaboration through distributed decisions and experience. These trade-offs motivate a systematic study of the space between the two regimes. We introduce Degrees of Freedom (DoF), a continuous configuration framework that quantifies the size of the decision space delegated to downstream agents. DoF controls the granularity of delegated work and the target probability that each task unit is assigned to the branches. Its endpoints recover the two coordination regimes. Across multiple task domains, DoF reveals a hierarchy of organizational effects. Delegated granularity and within-regime routing produce structured but bounded profile reallocations, whereas task domain and retained experience are associated with stronger differences between the centralized- and decentralized-branch profiles. The resulting performance landscape is task-dependent: different domains favor different DoF configurations, while atomic-target conditions are more consistent across runs. In-domain retained experience brings the two branch profiles closer together. The same controlled sweep reveals a task-dependent coordination landscape: some domains exhibit higher-performing configurations, whereas others show flatter responses and no single configuration dominates across domains. In five of the six evaluated state, an intermediate DoF configuration achieves higher mean accuracy than both endpoints, demonstrating the value of exploring the coordination space between them. Together, these findings provide empirical guidance for studying and designing intermediate coordination regimes in LLM-based MAS.

[MA-11] MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）在设计、运行与事后分析三个阶段中因研究碎片化导致的目标不一致与信号难以对齐的问题。现有工作通常局限于特定阶段或单一环节，缺乏跨阶段统一的量化框架，制约了系统整体性能的提升。其解决方案的关键在于提出MAS-Gate——一种基于节点中心的统一量化机制，将整个MAS生命周期建模为有向无环图（DAG），通过结合“节点内效用”（within-node utility，衡量节点对参考答案似然度变化的贡献）与“节点间强度”（inter-node strength，近似语义吸收能力及潜在下游影响），实现跨阶段的结构化表征。该统一量化方法被应用于三大核心任务：为编排器（Orchestrator）训练提供结构感知的密集奖励信号；训练编辑器（Editor）基于已编辑与未编辑轨迹的配对奖励进行运行时前缀干预；以及为大语言模型（LLM）驱动的事后归因提供风险排序节点作为辅助证据。实验结果表明，MAS-Gate在多跳问答、通用推理与错误定位等任务中均显著优于各阶段专用基线，验证了其作为贯穿MAS全生命周期的统一结构接口，在生成优化、动态编辑与错误归因方面的有效性与普适性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. Modeling each execution as a directed acyclic graph, MAS-Gate combines within-node utility, which estimates a node’s contribution through changes in reference-answer likelihood, with inter-node strength, which approximates semantic uptake and potential downstream reach. We adapt this shared quantification to three objectives: providing a structure-aware dense reward for Orchestrator training, training an Editor to act on execution prefixes using paired rewards from completed edited and unedited trajectories, and supplying risk-ranked nodes as auxiliary evidence for LLM-based post-hoc attribution. Experiments spanning interaction environments, knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, general reasoning, and post-hoc attribution demonstrate that MAS-Gate improves workflow construction, targeted runtime editing, and LLM-assisted error localization over corresponding phase-specific baselines. Together, these results establish MAS-Gate as a unified structural interface for improving MAS generation, dynamic editing, and error attribution throughout the lifecycle.

[MA-12] Mobility-Budget-Constrained Submodular Maximization for Distributed Semantic Multi-Robot Exploration IROS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在通信受限与移动能力受限条件下，多机器人协同探索中如何平衡信息增益与可达性的问题。其核心挑战在于，在分布式环境下，各机器人需在有限的资源预算下，自主决策具有高信息价值且可执行的探索路径，同时避免因过度依赖局部最优而导致全局性能下降。解决方案的关键在于提出一种分布式语义探索框架，融合狄利克雷映射（Dirichlet mapping）、预算约束的轨迹选择机制以及资源感知的分布式贪心（Resource-Aware distributed Greedy, RAG）协调策略。其中，每个机器人通过聚类前沿区域，基于单次预算受限的Dijkstra算法计算地形与航向感知的最小代价路径，并依据边际信息增益（以狄利克雷熵的期望降低量表示）筛选可行路径；该方法保证了每轮个体选择的精确性，团队整体每轮信息增益不低于集中式最优解的一半，且在通信受限时仍能保持良好的渐进性能衰减。实验表明，该方法在网格世界与逼真全系统仿真中均实现了更高的覆盖率、语义mIoU和地图置信度，同时单位距离的遍历成本与熵值更低，且唯一满足每条轨迹的移动预算约束，验证了其在实际应用中的有效性与鲁棒性。

类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the IROS 2026 SeMaNa Workshop. The first two authors contributed equally

Abstract:Multi-robot exploration under communication and mobility constraints requires balancing information gain with reachability. We present a distributed semantic exploration framework that combines Dirichlet mapping, budget-constrained trajectory selection, and Resource-Aware distributed Greedy (RAG) coordination. Each robot clusters frontiers, computes terrain- and heading-aware least-cost paths with a single budget-limited Dijkstra search, and selects feasible paths by marginal information gain, represented by the expected reduction in Dirichlet entropy. Each robot’s per-round selection is exact, the team’s joint per-round information gain is at least half the centralized optimum, and the bound degrades gracefully under limited communication. Ten-run gridworld ablations show improved coverage, semantic mIoU, and map certainty with lower entropy and traversal cost per unit distance than shortest-distance frontier selection. Budget-sensitivity experiments show that an intermediate budget best balances path reach and receding-horizon execution. In photorealistic full-system simulation against five coordination rules run in their native published forms, the proposed method attains the highest mean coverage and semantic accuracy while being the only one that respects the per-trajectory mobility budget.

[MA-13] Origin Attribution for Unsafe Behavior in Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Coding Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自演化多智能体编程系统中安全缺陷的溯源难题，即当不安全行为在多个智能体间传播并经过代码迭代后被发现时，如何准确识别其最初引入的智能体及对应程序版本。其核心挑战在于：代码重写会削弱文本相似性、独立发生的安全问题可能干扰时间顺序判断，且中间传递者与源智能体存在相似性，导致混淆。解决方案的关键在于提出一种融合行为指纹匹配（behavioral fingerprint matching）、历史定位（historical localization）与递归追溯（recursive tracing）的方法：通过比较候选实现的多维度行为特征，保留多个历史版本的证据，并沿代码演化路径向上追踪匹配项。在85个受控场景的158个查询中，该方法实现了96.8%的精确溯源准确率，显著优于无递归的全量指纹匹配（77.2%）。组件消融实验和34个额外查询验证表明，多代表样本与递归追溯具有互补作用；进一步扩展至审批边界错误与资源所有者错误的评估，充分证明了行为与历史证据协同在代码修订与跨智能体传播情境下恢复不安全行为起源的有效性。

作者: Hanyi Yu,Jiaming Cui
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:As language-model-based coding agents evolve their programs and reuse code from one another, safety failures can acquire a history that extends beyond the agent in which they are detected. An unsafe change may originate in one agent, propagate through intermediate recipients, and survive subsequent revisions before an audit reveals it. Understanding this history is important for identifying the introducing change and distinguishing inherited behavior from independently occurring failures. We study origin attribution in self-evolving multi-agent coding systems: recovering the agent and program version that introduced an observed unsafe behavior into the target’s code lineage, or determining that it arose locally. This task is challenging because rewriting obscures textual similarity, independent occurrences confound temporal ordering, and intermediate recipients can resemble the source. We propose a method that combines behavioral fingerprint matching with historical localization and recursive tracing. It compares candidate implementations beyond the unsafe outcome, retains evidence from multiple historical versions, and follows matching candidates upstream. On 158 queries across 85 controlled scenarios, the method achieves 96.8% exact attribution accuracy, compared with 77.2% for exhaustive fingerprint matching without recursion. Component ablations and evaluation on 34 additional queries using the same method and hyperparameters demonstrate the complementary roles of multiple representatives and recursive tracing. Further checks extend the evaluation to approval-boundary and resource-owner errors. Together, these results show how behavioral and historical evidence can recover the origins of unsafe behavior through code revision and cross-agent propagation.

[MA-14] Scaling Inference-Time Compute with Teams of Coding Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在推理扩展过程中面临的效率瓶颈问题：尽管引入多个智能体可并行协作以提升性能，但实际应用中常因任务重复、协调失败及计算成本上升而导致资源浪费。其核心挑战在于如何在有限的计算预算下，实现奖励与成本之间的帕累托最优（reward-cost Pareto frontier）。解决方案的关键在于将团队设计建模为一个计算资源分配问题，并通过系统性实验揭示不同阶段的计算投入对整体性能的影响。研究发现，将额外计算资源优先分配给规划阶段的智能体最具价值；使用低成本模型作为规划者能以极低代价获得接近全强模型团队的奖励增益，而廉价执行者或验证者则会降低性能；此外，规划者的边际收益随团队规模增长持续提升，而执行者和验证者的性能在超过四名成员后趋于饱和。这些发现共同构建了一个高效计算资源配置策略，指导用户根据任务特性、成本和延迟约束，精准分配智能体预算以实现最优性价比。

Abstract:Multi-agent systems promise a new axis for scaling inference: rather than having one agent think longer or sample more attempts, a task is split across many agents that work in parallel and coordinate. However, in practice, more agents can easily produce duplicate work, coordination failures, and higher costs. We therefore formulate team design as a compute allocation problem: starting from a solo agent, where should additional inference compute go to reach the reward-cost Pareto frontier? We build a minimal multi-agent harness from the ground up and trace this frontier by varying, one at a time, the workflow stage at which a lead delegates to its workers (planning, implementation, or verification), the models that form the team, and the number of workers. On ProgramBench, teams outperform solo agents but cost three to seven times as much. With the right compute allocation, however, a heterogeneous 17-agent team comes within 1.4 points of a strong homogeneous 5-agent team at 70% lower cost. This efficiency stems from three findings. First, planning is the most valuable use of workers: in a homogeneous team whose lead decides how many workers to spawn, a lead that delegates only planning to its workers, and then implements and verifies the code itself, matches the reward of a lead that delegates to workers throughout planning, implementation, and verification, at half the cost. Second, cheap models pay off as planners but not as implementers: a strong lead with cheap planners recovers 47.5% of the reward gain of an all-strong team for only 13.9% of its additional cost, whereas cheap implementers lower reward. Third, planners keep improving reward as the team grows, whereas implementers and verifiers plateau beyond four workers. Together, our results offer a guide to spending an agent budget where it counts, given the task, cost, and latency constraints a user has.

Abstract:Advances in large-scale machine learning have enabled agentic AI systems: persistent, autonomous computational entities that pursue goals, initiate actions, and interact with open environments. These systems are often framed as applications of foundation models. We argue that this framing is incomplete: agency is also a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science. What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. Where the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources: a process executes a program; an agent pursues a goal. From this perspective, the recurring failures of deployed agentic systems (runaway resource consumption, behavior redirected by adversarial content, opaque continuous operation) are symptoms of structural abstraction gaps, not isolated engineering defects. We examine these gaps across six dimensions (execution, interfaces, correctness, oversight, coordination, and persistence) and argue that closing them requires coordinated advances in systems,

[MA-16] DiTSG: Context-Aware Air Traffic Scene Generation with Multi-Agent Diffusion Transformers

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有空中交通模拟器难以有效捕捉空中交通管制员在实际运行中对多架航空器轨迹进行干预（如速度建议和雷达引导）的规律性问题，进而影响对空域内可安全高效管理的航空器数量及交通构型的准确评估。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于扩散模型的多智能体交通场景生成框架——扩散变换器交通场景生成（DiTSG），其关键在于采用堆叠的多智能体逆向变换器（multi-agent inverted Transformer）作为去噪主干网络，联合生成同一交通场景中多架航空器的轨迹，并以各航空器特定的预计到达时间（Required Time of Arrival, RTA）作为生成条件。该方法能够有效保留真实空管运行中观测到的航空器间交互特性，实验表明所生成的交通场景在统计特性上复现了真实数据特征，同时具备高度多样性与现实合理性。

Abstract:Understanding how many aircraft, and which traffic configurations, can be safely and efficiently managed by air traffic controllers within a given airspace is fundamental to air traffic management. Air traffic controllers continuously modify aircraft trajectories through interventions such as speed advisories and radar vectoring, and the patterns of these interventions are difficult to capture effectively using existing air traffic simulators. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Transformers for Traffic Scene Generation (DiTSG), which learns to generate air traffic scenes from recorded multi-aircraft trajectories. DiTSG employs stacked multi-agent inverted Transformer layers as the denoising backbone of a diffusion transformer, jointly generates the trajectories of multiple aircraft within a traffic scene, and conditions the generation on agent-specific required times of arrival. The resulting trajectories generated by DiTSG preserve realistic inter-aircraft interactions observed in actual air traffic operations. Experiments show that the DiTSG generates diverse traffic scenes that reproduce the statistical properties of recorded traffic while preserving realistic inter-aircraft interactions.

[MA-17] Game-Creation-Agents : Autonomous Game Production

【速读】：该论文旨在解决从自然语言指令自动生成可运行的网页游戏（基于Phaser 4框架）这一复杂任务中的系统性挑战，核心问题在于如何将非结构化的文本需求转化为兼具功能完整性、视觉一致性与可执行性的高质量游戏产品。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个分阶段、多智能体协同的生成式流水线：首先通过多模态游戏设计文档（multimodal game design document）将游戏机制与场景契约（scene contracts）与具象化视觉参考相耦合，形成可执行的设计基准；随后将设计文档投影为可机器读取的运行时架构、确定性测试用例与合约规范；再由八个专业化智能体并行执行场景实现、资产生成与构建整合，其中通过一个简化版清单（reduced manifest）实现双分支融合；最后通过构建关联的实时UI验证与代码盲评（code-blind critic）进行质量门控检查，任何失败项将触发归属智能体的有限修复，直至所有质量关卡通过后方可发布。该方法在独立评估中展现出更强的需求满足度、核心机制完备性、内容深度及功能性视觉表现，并在人机对比实验中获得更高评分与偏好。

Abstract:Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA’s games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

[MA-18] Agent Cue: Statistical Summaries for Guiding Decentralized Multi-Agent Self-Organization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模多智能体系统（Multi-agent Systems, MAS）在去中心化协作中因信息爆炸导致的效率下降问题。随着智能体数量增加，各智能体在共享板上不断记录参与与协作行为，导致信息量呈指数级增长，智能体需耗费大量计算资源读取历史记录，从而削弱了自组织能力。针对这一挑战，论文提出AgentCue方法，其核心在于构建一个基于潜在空间模型（latent space model）的新框架，将智能体与任务类型共同嵌入同一潜在空间中。通过持续更新协作网络与参与网络，并利用潜在空间模型对这些网络进行参数估计，生成紧凑且可解释的统计摘要。智能体仅需参考该统计摘要即可高效选择子任务与合作者，避免重复遍历共享板。研究证明了潜在空间模型的可识别性，并给出了在网络增量下的非渐近误差界，进一步表明每次网络更新后进行固定次数的梯度迭代即可维持稳定的估计精度。在LongBench v2多文档问答任务上的实验验证了AgentCue在有效性、效率和可解释性方面的优越表现。

Abstract:Multi-agent systems (MAS) combine multiple agents to solve complex tasks, and recent MAS scale to more than a thousand agents. At this scale, decentralized MAS remove the central orchestrator that assigns sub-tasks, and the agents, which we call workers, self-organize through their own choices of sub-tasks and collaborators on a shared board. As workers keep adding participation and collaboration records, however, the information explodes: workers spend more and more effort on reading the records of other workers, and self-organization loses efficiency. In the statistical view, we represent the execution history of an MAS by two continually updated networks, a collaboration network among workers and a participation network between workers and task types. We then propose AgentCue, a method built on a new latent space model that places workers and task types in a shared latent space. Each time the networks are updated, the estimated parameters of the latent space model form a compact and interpretable statistical summary, and workers use the statistical summary to choose sub-tasks and collaborators without repeated searches of the shared board. We establish the identifiability of the latent space model and non-asymptotic error bounds for the estimates under network increments, and we show that a fixed number of gradient updates after each network update suffices for the same error rate. Experiments on LongBench v2 Multi-Doc QA show that AgentCue achieves competitive effectiveness, efficiency, and interpretability.

[MA-19] Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统与物理环境中普遍存在的一种分级稀疏机制（graded sparse mechanism）的建模与学习问题，即系统中每个元素的更新依赖于少数关键元素，而对大多数元素的影响较弱，且哪些元素重要及其影响程度随系统状态动态变化。尽管此类机制在群体行为、人群模拟、粒子模拟器及图网络的邻域聚合中广泛存在，但其作为一类具有“分级”特性的函数尚未得到系统的理论研究。本文的核心贡献在于：首先通过一组公理化定义该类函数——包括权重对影响的上限约束、权重依赖的平滑性以及对称性（无特殊元素被强调），并证明了一个表示定理：该类函数恰好构成加权多重集上某种运输度量（transport metric）的Lipschitz球，且该度量由公理唯一确定。这一几何结构为泛化误差提供了双重保障：一方面，泛化界依赖于数据的稀疏性分布特征（sparsity profile）——即有多少元素参与作用及其权重分布，该界以稀疏性分布决定的指数形式呈现，不随总元素数量增长而恶化，并在多个自然情形下给出了匹配的下界；另一方面，基于表示结果，经典的经验偏差界可直接应用于该函数类，其上界为样本两半在该度量下的运输距离（可通过匹配精确计算），并附加一个浓度项。最后，作者在不同交互规则与噪声水平下的模拟维克塞克（Vicsek） flock 模型中验证了该泛化证书的有效性，表明其非平凡（non-vacuous），仅占原始上界的一小部分。因此，解决方案的关键在于：通过公理化构建具有明确几何结构的函数类，并利用运输度量的性质实现对稀疏性依赖的精准刻画与泛化分析。

Abstract:In a variety of multi-agent and physical environments, an element’s update depends strongly on a few other elements and weakly on many, and both the identity and the number of the elements that matter change with the state of the system. Such graded sparse mechanisms are common, for instance, in flocks, crowds, learned particle simulators and the neighborhood aggregation of graph networks, yet they have received little systematic study as a class of functions with the grading given. In this paper we study the supervised learning of the mechanism when the grading is provided by the environment, as a weight on every element. First, we define the class by axioms, where each element’s influence is capped by its weight, the dependence on the weights is regular, and no element is distinguished, and prove a representation theorem: the class is exactly the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, and the metric is forced by the axioms. Next, the geometry of the representation gives generalization bounds that depend on the data in two ways. One is via the sparsity profile of the data – the law of how many elements matter and by how much – which bounds the rate over all designs with that profile, with an exponent from the profile and no dependence on the number of elements. In a number of natural cases we also show matching lower bounds, up to constants in the exponent. The other is empirical: due to the representation result, classical empirical discrepancy bounds apply to the class as they stand, and the resulting bound is the transport distance between the two halves of the sample in the class’s own metric, computed exactly by a matching, with an additional concentration term. Finally, we study a simulated Vicsek flock under four interaction rules at two noise levels, and show that the certificate is non-vacuous, a small fraction of the trivial value on every rule.

[MA-20] RelLedger: Relational Information Governance for LLM Agent Organizations ICLR2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体组织中共享记录机制所引发的因果模糊性问题，即在多轮交互历史中，难以追溯特定事实报告决策的驱动因素，也无法判断该记录对下游决策的实际影响。其核心挑战在于：当不同历史路径间存在“交付差距”（delivery gap）时，无法明确是何种关系或线索控制了发送者的报告行为，以及该信息是否真正影响后续任务。为此，论文提出RelLedger这一审计框架，其关键在于通过固定事件、证据、风险与消息内容，交叉对比发送者在不同历史背景（如目标对象与无关角色）下的行为差异，结合角色重分配与历史重写技术以定位控制性线索；并通过消息干预与成本干预识别效应出现的时间节点。此外，归因账本（attribution ledger）将每项声明与其所需响应单元关联，区分缺失干预与采样不确定性；接收方回放机制则追踪已传递信息在下游决策中的演化路径。在模拟单人公司的可执行工作流中，该方法进一步扩展至检索历史、工具调用及共享账本更新的审计。实验表明，不同模型存在特异性的控制路径，且显式损失规则下关系差距更小；例如，Claude在冲突历史中报告同一事实的概率比友好历史高出62.22个百分点，而在可执行工作流中，紧张历史使接收方审查率较温暖历史降低45.83个百分点，揭示了关系动态对决策链的显著影响。

Abstract:In LLM agent organizations, shared records determine which facts are available for later decisions. A sender consults interaction histories before deciding whether to report an event. A delivery gap across histories does not show whose relationship drove the choice or whether the resulting record matters downstream. We introduce RelLedger to audit these links. It holds the event, evidence, risk, and message fixed while crossing the sender’s histories with the event target and an unrelated actor. Role reassignment and history rewrites locate the controlling cue. Message and cost interventions show when the effect appears. An attribution ledger maps each claim to its required response cells and separates missing interventions from sampling uncertainty. Recipient replay follows delivered information into downstream decisions. Executable workflows for a simulated one-person company extend the audit to retrieved histories, tool calls, and shared ledger updates. Across GPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Qwen, the audit reveals model-specific control paths and smaller relation gaps under explicit loss rules. Claude sends the same factual notice 62.22 percentage points more often with conflict histories than with friendly histories. In executable workflows, strained histories reduce recipient review rates by 45.83 points relative to warm histories for Claude.

[MA-21] Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay ICTAI2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决代理框架在执行、治理与重放过程中因身份分离而导致的一致性与可验证性问题。现有框架通常将执行、治理和重放逻辑割裂，导致状态不一致或难以追溯。其解决方案的关键在于提出Pollard——一种基于受控语义执行树（governed semantic execution trees）的框架无关运行时。该机制通过严格定义步骤身份（step identity），使其绑定到规范输入、操作类型、尝试次数及父节点身份，确保所有执行结果（完成、拒绝、资源结算、分支历史）均记录于同一不可变树结构中。通过签名确定性冻结（signed deterministic freeze）实现严格重放，无需重新调用被封装操作即可返回经验证的存储结果；同时采用事务性存储协调并发工作负载间的资源预留。实验验证表明，在租约保留、边界约束和封印托管等假设下，系统能有效检测所有语义变更且无误报，多对框架矩阵保持参考行为一致性，且在真实服务路径测试中每个完成的Pollard试验均生成可验证的执行树，充分支持其核心机制的可靠性与可审计性。

Abstract:Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的多智能体系统在规模扩展时面临的三大瓶颈问题：随着智能体数量增加导致的阅读负担上升、因未知质量的共享工作而造成有用信息被稀释，以及对失败智能体的脆弱性。现有方法主要采用以智能体为中心的设计模式，其协调机制固化于固定流程、中心化协调器或点对点通信中，尽管近期的黑板式方法将协调机制转移到共享媒介中，仅缓解了最后一个挑战。为克服上述局限，作者提出ScaleMAS系统，其核心创新在于构建一个异步智能体通过三个操作与共享消息数据存储进行交互的架构：发布消息并可选择性引用先前消息以构建依赖关系、基于内容搜索消息、以及通过地址访问消息。其中，搜索操作最多返回k条结果，确保任意群体规模下智能体的读取开销保持恒定；搜索结果按相关性和引用频率排序，后者被证实是信息质量的有效代理指标；同时，消息在生产者离开后仍持久存在，从而实现个体智能体失效后的系统持续运行。实验表明，ScaleMAS在四项代理任务中均以更低的推理计算成本优于以智能体为中心和黑板式基线方法，并可稳定扩展至128个智能体，且具备良好的容错能力。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Existing large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems have been shown to scale poorly, and we identify three problems: reading burden that grows with the group, useful information diluted by shared work of unknown quality, and fragility to failed agents. We argue that the problems are largely due to agent-centric designs: the coordination structure is wired into fixed workflows, central coordinators, or peer-to-peer messaging, and recent blackboard-style methods that move the coordination into a shared medium relieve only the last problem. To close the gaps, we build ScaleMAS, where asynchronous agents interact with a shared datastore of linked messages via three operations: publishing messages with optional references to earlier ones that they build on, searching for messages by content, and visiting messages by address. Search returns at most k messages, so an agent’s read stays bounded at any group size; results are ranked by relevance and by how often they are cited, which we find to be an effective proxy for quality; and messages persist after their producers leave, so the group carries on when individual agents fail. Across four agentic tasks, ScaleMAS outperforms agent-centric and blackboard-style baselines at lower inference compute, continues to scale up to 128 agents, and tolerates losing agents midway.

[MA-23] Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues

Abstract:LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at this https URL.

[MA-24] GUIDE: Computationally Augmented Consensus for Trustworthy Clinical Practice Guidelines

【速读】：该论文旨在解决临床实践指南（Clinical Practice Guidelines, CPGs）更新滞后的问题，其核心挑战在于证据爆炸式增长与专家共识形成过程复杂性之间的矛盾。为应对这一问题，研究提出了一种多智能体协作式人工智能助手系统GUIDE，其关键在于通过专业化分工的AI代理承担文献检索、证据评级等重复性高强度任务，同时保留人类专家在关键判断环节（如偏倚风险评估、推荐意见制定）中的最终决策权，实现人机协同的高效指南生成与更新。实验表明，GUIDE在眼科领域12个NICE数据集上实现了88.85%的文献召回率、86.06%的证据确定性评级一致性及91.67%的推荐意见一致率，平均每个数据集仅需162.17分钟且仅需28.68%的人工干预；在心内科、内分泌科、消化科和呼吸科共20个额外数据集上表现稳定，并在去除专家干预后显著降低关键判断步骤性能，验证了专家参与的必要性。此外，在前瞻性真实世界验证中，GUIDE显著减轻专家工作负荷，生成的推荐意见临床可接受性（均值3.73 vs. 1.53）和一致性（66.7% vs. 13.3%）远超十年旧版指南，且与纯人工更新效果相当（P = 0.588），但耗时与投入大幅减少。因此，GUIDE提供了一个兼具时效性、可信度与专家主导性的指南开发范式，验证了计算增强型共识形成的可行性。

Abstract:Maintaining up-to-date clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) is essential for evidence-based medicine, but rapid evidence growth and complex expert consensus formation limit timely updates. We developed GUIDE, a multi-agent copilot system for human-AI collaborative guideline generation and updating. GUIDE delegates labor-intensive tasks to specialized AI agents while preserving expert judgment and final arbitration. In 12 NICE ophthalmology datasets, GUIDE achieved 88.85% literature recall, 86.06% alignment in certainty-of-evidence ratings, and 91.67% recommendation agreement, requiring 162.17 minutes per dataset on average (28.68% human intervention). Performance remained stable across 20 additional datasets from cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, and respiratory medicine. Ablation analysis showed that removing expert intervention reduced performance in judgment-intensive steps such as Risk-of-Bias assessment. In six post-cutoff datasets, GUIDE maintained robust end-to-end performance on unseen evidence. Prospective real-world validation showed that GUIDE reduced expert workload and produced more clinically acceptable recommendations than the original decade-old guideline (mean score, 3.73 vs. 1.53; agreement, 66.7% vs. 13.3%), with outcomes comparable to human-only updating (P = 0.588) but substantially less time and effort. GUIDE offers a practical framework for timely, trustworthy, expert-centric guideline development and validates computationally augmented consensus.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统在实际部署中缺乏可靠运行时审计器的问题，即如何从已观测到的执行前缀（execution prefix）准确预测最终执行结果。现有方法依赖有限且经过验证的轨迹数据集进行训练，但扩展该数据集需耗费大量执行与验证成本，且仅扩大失败覆盖范围无法提供明确标准以识别当前审计器难以分类的前缀。为此，本文提出Dream2Discern，其核心创新在于通过自监督的隐式增强机制，利用审计器自身预测损失驱动生成更具挑战性的难例。具体而言，在Dream阶段，通过对审计器的表示算子施加扰动，使已有前缀的预测损失最大化，从而生成“困难的潜在变体”；在Discern阶段，审计器基于原始标签学习从这些变体中预测执行结果。随着模型持续学习，变体被动态重生成，将有限的数据集转化为可再生的难例来源，无需额外轨迹采集或结果验证。实验表明，Dream2Discern在AFTraj-2K和StepShield两个基准上均达到超过90%的轨迹级加权准确率，显著优于现有方法，在预测准确性与实时性之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract:Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. To this end, we propose Dream2Discern, a runtime auditor trained through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss. During Dream, we select perturbations of the auditor’s representation operators to increase prediction loss on recorded prefixes, yielding hard latent variants. During Discern, the auditor learns to predict execution outcomes from these variants using the original labels. The variants are regenerated as the auditor learns, turning a limited corpus into a renewable source of hard examples and requiring no additional trajectory collection or outcome verification. Extensive evaluations on AFTraj-2K and StepShield show that Dream2Discern outperforms competitive failure auditors and achieves over 90% trajectory-level weighted accuracy on both benchmarks while balancing prediction accuracy and timeliness. Abstract:In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs’ ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator’s worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at this https URL.

Abstract:Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies’ Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在代理环境（agent environment）中因验证器（verifier）可被攻击而引发的奖励劫持（reward hacking）问题。具体而言，现有验证器可能被恶意代理利用，使其在未完成目标任务的情况下仍获得全额奖励，导致评估结果失真及训练过程出现偏差。随着代理环境数量与复杂度的提升，验证器的安全性亟需增强。为此，论文提出一种可扩展、全自动的“弱到强”验证器加固方法，其核心在于构建一个隔离的验证器沙箱以防止代理直接篡改验证逻辑，并引入“黑客-修复者循环”（hacker-fixer loop）机制，通过迭代式漏洞探测与修复实现防御能力的持续增强。该方法在Terminal Bench、KernelBench和SETA等多个基准环境中显著降低了攻击成功率，且随着迭代次数增加，防御强度呈递增趋势，优于静态非迭代基线方案。该方法的早期版本已被官方Terminal Bench仓库采纳，用于审计环境中的漏洞，体现了其实际应用价值。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agent environments are essential for large language model (LLM) development. They use programmatic verifiers to turn complex outcomes into rewards. Verifiers can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents without completing the intended task, causing inaccurate evaluation and misalignment in training. As agent environments scale in numbers and difficulty, so must the repairing of exploitable verifiers. To this end, we ask whether today’s model with scaled compute can automatically harden agent environments to prevent potentially stronger future models from reward hacking. We introduce a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening. It first sets up an isolated verifier sandbox that agents cannot directly modify, then uses a hacker-fixer loop to find and repair remaining verifier vulnerabilities. We apply this loop to Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA, substantially reducing attack success across these agent environments. The iterative design scales with the hardening budget, producing progressively stronger defenses as the number of loop iterations increases and outperforming the static, non-iterative baseline. An earlier version of our hacker-fixer loop has been adopted by the official Terminal Bench repository as a way to audit exploits in its environments. Project page: this https URL. [MA-29] Mind Your Own Role: Reducing Role Overstepping for Effective and Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Dynamic Role Activation Steering

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent Systems, MAS）在执行复杂任务时，智能体因职责越界（role overstepping）而执行其他角色的子任务所导致的工作流紊乱、系统效率下降及任务性能退化的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种轻量级且高效的推理阶段激活干预方法——动态角色激活引导（Dynamic Role Activation Steering, DRAS）。DRAS的关键在于通过分析模型内部激活空间中的角色相关模式，发现角色指令会引发激活空间中一致的方向性偏移，且遵循角色与越界行为的轨迹在激活模式上具有显著差异。基于此，DRAS为每个角色构建一个角色引导向量和一个轻量级越界检测器；在大语言模型（LLM）生成过程中，检测器根据当前激活状态实时估计越界概率，并动态调整引导强度，从而将智能体的生成轨迹精准引导回其本职职责。实验表明，相较于原始MAS，DRAS可将角色越界轨迹减少高达86.6%，显著提升任务质量评分10.0%–11.1%，实现1.50×–1.61×的任务完成速度提升，并降低26.8%–38.7%的令牌消耗。

Abstract:Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have shown strong capability in solving complex tasks by assigning different agents specialized roles and corresponding subtasks. However, agents may overstep their assigned responsibilities and perform subtasks belonging to other roles, which can disrupt workflow, reduce system efficiency, and degrade task performance. To address this issue, we investigate role-related patterns in the model’s internal activation space and uncover two key observations: (i) role instructions induce consistent directional shifts in activation space, and (ii) role-adherent and role-overstepping trajectories exhibit distinct activation patterns. Based on these observations, we propose Dynamic Role Activation Steering (DRAS), a lightweight and effective inference-time activation intervention approach to reduce role overstepping in multi-agent collaboration. Specifically, DRAS constructs a role steering vector and a lightweight role-overstepping detector for each role. During LLM generation, the detector estimates the probability of role overstepping from the current activation state, and DRAS dynamically adjusts the steering strength accordingly to guide the agent toward its assigned responsibilities. Experimental results show that DRAS effectively reduces the number of role-overstepping trajectories by up to 86.6% compared with Vanilla MAS, thereby improving task quality score by 10.0%–11.1%, achieving a 1.50 \times --1.61 \times task-completion speedup, and reducing token consumption by 26.8%–38.7%.

[MA-30] Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）代理团队在协作过程中表现出的典型社会性失效问题，如信息持有者沉默、主导发言者固执于错误答案以及规范违规行为未被纠正等。其核心解决方案是提出“代理社会剧”（Agent Sociodrama）框架，通过统一的外部LLM裁判对代理的情绪状态及具有方向性和非对称性的社会关系进行每轮更新，从而动态建模和验证代理团队中的社会演化过程。在此基础上，进一步引入轨迹引导型人格重塑（Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting, TPR），利用交互日志与社会轨迹诊断群体动态失败，并重构代理人格以修复协作缺陷。实验表明，TPR在四个协作基准任务中显著提升了性能，相较于初始人格配置最高实现83.3个百分点的准确率提升；在分布式信息合作与混合动机谈判等复杂场景中，其帕累托效率优于SOTOPIA和AgentVerse，最高提升达37.5个百分点。结果证明，经过验证的社会演化轨迹可作为可操作的信号，用于主动修复和优化LLM代理团队的协作效能。

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents’ emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. We then introduce Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and social trajectories and recasts agent personas before rerunning the task. Across four collaborative benchmarks, TPR improves performance from both heterogeneous and randomly initialized agent persona compositions, yielding up to 83.3%p of accuracy improvement over the initial casting. On representative distributed-information cooperation and mixed-motive bargaining tasks, we outperform SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons, by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate. These results show that validated social trajectories provide actionable signals for repairing LLM agent teams.

[MA-31] Dynamic Conflict Clustering with Lightweight Learning and Strategic Repair for Distributed Constraint Satisfaction

【速读】：该论文旨在解决分布式约束满足问题（DCSP）中因传统求解器依赖广泛且重复的点对点通信、缺乏战略协调与学习能力而导致的通信开销大、易陷入停滞状态以及难以求解复杂实例的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于修复机制的动态冲突聚类-不完全求解器（DCC-Incomplete），关键在于通过冲突中心化的分解策略，将未求解部分划分为冲突簇，并利用协调层限制通信范围至同一冲突区域内的代理；同时引入记忆引导的重启机制，使代理与冲突簇能够根据邻近冲突状态暂停、修正并自适应调整修复策略。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了求解成功率（从37.50%提升至61.11%），降低了中位运行时间（从0.565s降至0.367s）和中位通信量（每约束消息数从12.493降至6.503），验证了动态冲突聚类结合轻量化战略与学习引导修复在提升通信效率与求解鲁棒性方面的有效性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Distributed Constraint Satisfaction Problems (DCSPs) model distributed decision-making in multi-agent systems, where agents assign values to local variables while satisfying shared constraints. However, many DCSP solvers still rely on broad, repeated peer-to-peer communication and are largely reactive, with limited support for strategic coordination or learning. This increases communication overhead, can lead to stagnation, and reduces the success of hard instances. Hence, we propose Dynamic Conflict Clustering-Incomplete (DCC-Incomplete), a repair-based solver that combines conflict-centred decomposition, structured coordination, strategic repair, and lightweight learning for stagnation recovery. DCC-Incomplete groups the unsolved part of the problem into conflict clusters and restricts communication via a coordination layer to agents within the same conflict region. It also introduces memory-guided restart, enabling agents and clusters to pause, revise, and adapt repairs based on neighbouring conflict states. A thorough evaluation of DCC-Incomplete on distributed graph-colouring benchmarks with planted satisfying assignments shows that its memory-guided restart improves the success rate from 37.50% to 61.11%, reduces median runtime from 0.565s to 0.367s, and cuts median communication from 12.493 to 6.503 messages per constraint. These results suggest that dynamic conflict clustering, combined with lightweight strategic and learning-guided repair, improves both communication efficiency and robustness in incomplete DCSP solving.

[MA-32] Representation Theorems for Actual Powers over Two-Agent General Concurrent Game Frames

【速读】：该论文旨在解决传统并发博弈框架（concurrent game frames）中权力表征的局限性问题，特别是基于α效用性（alpha effectivity）定义的联盟权力所隐含的单调性缺陷：该定义无法区分联盟通过不同联合行动实现的相同结果集，从而掩盖了实际行动策略的差异。为此，论文采用由van Benthem、Bezhanishvili和Enqvist（2019）提出的“实际权力”（basic power）概念，即以联盟的每种联合行动及其对其他参与者可能行动的全集所对应的可达状态集合来刻画其权力结构。进一步地，针对Li与Ju（2025, 2026）指出的标准并发博弈框架中三个可能过强的假设——序列性（seriality）、代理间的独立性（independence of agents）以及确定性（determinism），论文在仅考虑双代理人情形下，系统分析了由此产生的八类广义并发博弈框架，并证明这些框架在实际权力意义下可被八类对应的邻域框架（neighborhood frames）精确表示。这一结果扩展了van Benthem等人（2019）的代表性定理，为博弈论与逻辑之间的连接提供了更精细、更具包容性的形式化基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15476
作者: Zixuan Chen(Institute for Logic, Language and Computation, University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, The Netherlands),Fengkui Ju(School of Philosophy, Beijing Normal University, Beijing, China),Thomas Ågotnes(Department of Information Science and Media Studies, University of Bergen, Bergen, Norway and School of Philosophy, Shanxi University, Taiyuan, China)
机构: 未知
类目: Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: In Proceedings GandALF 2026, arXiv:2610.08898 . Corresponding author: Fengkui Ju

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One of the most well-known connections between logic and games is Pauly’s representation theorem: the induced powers of individuals and coalitions in concurrent game frames correspond, in a precise sense, to a certain class of neighborhood frames. The precise sense here is what is called alpha effectivity (or alpha power): the power of a coalition is characterized by the sets of states in which it can ensure that the outcome lies by taking some joint action. This definition is inherently monotonic, and, as pointed out by van Benthem, Bezhanishvili, and Enqvist (2019), that fact can obscure relevant information about the power structure in the game: we do not know whether two sets that a coalition has the power to enforce correspond to the same joint action or to different joint actions. An alternative is to characterize the power of a coalition by its actual power (called basic power by van Benthem, Bezhanishvili, and Enqvist (2019)): the collection of sets of states, each of which corresponds to one joint action by the coalition and all possible joint actions by the other agents. It has recently been argued by Li and Ju (2025, 2026) that standard concurrent game frames rely on three assumptions that may, in some cases, be too strong: seriality, independence of agents, and determinism. This yields a total of eight different classes of general concurrent game frames. In this paper, assuming two agents, we prove that, in terms of actual powers, the eight classes of general concurrent game frames are represented by eight corresponding classes of neighborhood frames. This generalizes a result by van Benthem, Bezhanishvili, and Enqvist (2019).

[MA-33] CoLA: Multi-VLA Coordination via Learned Adapters

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体协作中何时需要显式通信的问题，特别是在共享工作空间的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型场景下。现有方法通常依赖于隐式观察或显式消息传递来实现协调，但缺乏对通信必要性的系统性分析。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为CoLA（Coordination via Learned Adapters）的新架构：在保持各智能体原有VLA主干网络冻结的前提下，仅通过训练轻量级的消息通道与每个机械臂对应的扩散动作头，实现完全去中心化的执行。实验表明，当信息具有私密性（如仅一个智能体可见遮挡托盘上的颜色标记）时，显式通信显著提升性能（成功率达76.0%），而当信息可通过共享视角（如共用俯视摄像头）获取时，移除消息对性能影响可忽略；此外，该架构具备良好的泛化能力，适用于不同VLA主干网络，并在参数效率和任务表现上优于基于LoRA微调的基线方法。

机构: MARS Lab; Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; Autonomous Agents Research Group
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 22 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Ahaskar Kashyap, Jiawen Zong, Boyu Ma. Code: this https URL

Abstract:Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically deployed as isolated single-agent policies. When several such agents share a workspace, they can coordinate implicitly, by observing one another, or explicitly, by exchanging messages, but it remains unclear when explicit communication becomes necessary. We introduce CoLA (Coordination via Learned Adapters), which keeps each agent’s VLA backbone frozen and trains a lightweight message channel and a per-arm diffusion action head on top, with fully decentralised execution. Across three tasks that differ in how much each agent can observe, the channel matters only when information is private. On an occluded tray handover, where the box’s colour marker is visible to one agent only, CoLA reaches 76.0% success versus 1.3% with messages zeroed throughout training. On two-arm and three-arm handover tasks, removing messages has no measurable effect with a shared overhead camera (90.6% vs. 88.3% at two arms; 63.5% vs. 60.0% at three), but lowers success on the two-arm task’s wrist-only variant (74.8% vs. 64.3%). This architecture generalises across different VLA backbones as well. With a frozen \pi_0.5 backbone on the same occluded tray task, CoLA matches the overall success rate of a LoRA-fine-tuned baseline (37.3% vs. 34.7%) using a fraction of the trainable parameters. When CoLA places the box, it selects the correct tray 71.8% of the time, whereas the independently fine-tuned baseline, whose placing arm never sees the marker, selects it at chance level (34.7% against 33.3%).

[MA-34] Do Rollups Self-Organize? Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in the EIP-4844 Blob Fee Market

【速读】：该论文旨在解决以太坊分片（EIP-4844）中数据区块（blob）费用机制在多参与方、动态博弈环境下的稳定性与效率问题，尤其关注多个独立、自利的rollup如何在缺乏协调的情况下共同实现目标数据量（每区块3个blob）的供给。传统分析仅能处理单一代理在外部价格假设下的最优行为或静态均衡情形，无法刻画真实市场中异质rollup之间的复杂互动。为此，作者提出一个校准后的多智能体强化学习（multi-agent reinforcement learning, MARL）仿真环境，其中基础费用由EIP-4844规则根据异质rollup的聚合行为内生决定。研究发现，在无收敛保证的独立学习者设定下，系统仍能稳定趋近目标供给水平（3.32±0.01 blob/区块），并在需求范围扩大50倍（10×至500×）时，供给维持在目标附近（10×至200×需求区间），仅在极高需求下超出目标，此时费用调控失效。此外，滚子规模越大，其数据提交频率越高，呈现出与前期理论预测一致的“规模阈值”现象。值得注意的是，引入零成本的Layer-1 calldata作为外部选项后，费用下降约一个数量级，但总供给仍保持在目标水平，表明该费用规则本质上起到了对去中心化供给的负反馈控制作用。

Abstract:EIP-4844 gave Ethereum rollups a separate fee dimension for data, governed by a multiplicative update rule that targets three ``blobs’’ per block. Whether this target is reached depends on how many independent, self-interested rollups choose to post data, a question that closed-form models address only for a single agent under exogenous prices or in a static equilibrium. We propose a calibrated multi-agent reinforcement learning environment for the blob fee market in which the blob base fee is endogenous, set by the EIP-4844 rule on the aggregated decisions of heterogeneous rollups fit to post-Dencun Ethereum data. After confirming that the environment reproduces the known single-agent analytical optimum, we show that independent learners, with no convergence guarantee, still settle near the target without coordination ( 3.32\pm0.01 blobs per block over five seeds). Over a fiftyfold demand range ( 10\times to 500\times ), supply stays at the target from 10\times to 200\times and rises above it at higher demand, where the fee can no longer hold it. Posting frequency increases with rollup size, an emergent analog of the size threshold predicted by prior theory. A costless layer-1 calldata outside option pushes the fee down by roughly an order of magnitude while aggregate supply stays at the target, so the fee rule acts as a negative-feedback controller on decentralized supply.

[MA-35] Persistent LLM Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Teams via Partial Delegation to Multi-Agent Protocols

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在动态、非终止环境中，基于自然语言指令的多机器人团队任务规划中，大语言模型（LLM）因环境持续变化和任务长期性导致的性能退化问题。现有方法依赖于任务终态与静态环境的假设，但在灾害救援等实际场景中，任务持续进行且环境不断演化（如火势蔓延、幸存者移动），使得传统框架失效。其核心挑战表现为：提示（prompt）长度无限制增长、推理能力随代理与目标数量增加而下降、以及完成一次搜索空间覆盖后停止主动监控。为应对这些问题，论文提出基于“具身生成智能”（grounded generative intelligence）框架的改进方案：首先引入马尔可夫状态摘要（Markovian state summary），通过每次调用时从语义地图重建状态，替代不断膨胀的交互历史；其次采用部分委派（partial delegation）机制，将部分机器人交由自主多智能体协议管理，仅保留对需精细参数与顺序控制的子任务进行高层规划；最后通过显式表达观测过期（observation staleness）并结合任务与事件触发的重新提示机制，确保系统持续保持警觉。在模拟城市搜救任务中，该框架在火势扩散与人员移动的动态环境下，成功救助98%的平民，显著优于最强基线的89%，同时使用令牌数减少6倍。消融实验进一步验证了各机制的有效性。

机构: University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); University of Pennsylvania (宾夕法尼亚大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Natural language specifications let non-expert users task robot teams, and large language models (LLMs) have recently proven effective at grounding such semantic specifications into plans for heterogeneous teams. Existing approaches assume missions that terminate and environments that, while unknown, do not change, but both assumptions fail in many emerging applications. For example, a disaster-response mission does not terminate, and its environment changes continuously as hazards spread and evacuees move. We identify three ways an LLM orchestrator breaks in this setting: its prompt grows without bound, its reasoning degrades as agents and targets accumulate, and it stops actively monitoring after covering the search space once. We build on the successful framework of grounded generative intelligence, and address each issue with a classical idea. A Markovian state summary, rebuilt from the semantic map at every invocation, replaces the growing interaction history. Partial delegation lets the orchestrator assign a subset of robots to an autonomous multi-agent protocol and reserve its reasoning for generating subtasks that require detailed parameters and careful ordering. Lastly, observation staleness, surfaced explicitly in the prompt, together with task-and event-triggered re-prompting, keeps the team vigilant. In a simulated urban search-and-rescue mission with spreading fire and moving evacuees, our framework rescues 98% of civilians versus 89% for the strongest baseline while using six times fewer tokens. Additional ablations isolate the contribution of each mechanism.

[MA-36] Continuous Risk-Based Scheduling for Food Safety Inspection: Integrating Historical Decay with Event-Driven Consumer Review Signals

Abstract:Batch risk-based inspection scheduling struggles to detect a critical failure class: food facilities with recent clean inspections that subsequently develop severe violations. Traditional systems recompute risk on fixed planning cycles using static historical data, leaving blind spots between inspection cycles. To address this, we introduce the Continuous Inspection Risk (CIR) system, an event-driven scheduling pipeline that re-ranks the inspection queue dynamically as new data arrives. CIR combines a decay-weighted historical score with a stream of real-time consumer reviews triaged by a language-model classifier. A key structural contribution is our temporal partition rule, which strictly excludes reviews predating the most recent inspection to prevent superseded signals from skewing current risk. Evaluating CIR on 9,505 routine inspections in Santa Clara County, California (2024-2026), we show that history-based scoring alone reduces mean time-to-detection of major violations by 69 days (20.9%) under a 30% inspection budget, but fails to anticipate severe vermin-related closures (0/8 detected). Incorporating post-inspection review signals drastically improves performance, predicting 7 of 8 vermin closures with an average lead time of 117 days-firing on the exact day of review publication in four instances. Introducing a review corroboration rule improves precision from 0.70 to 0.78 without loss of recall. Finally, we analyze critical implementation challenges, documenting a data-hygiene pitfall (stale review leakage across inspection boundaries) and an evaluation limitation involving unobserved facility self-remediation. This work provides the first case-level evaluation of event-driven inspection triggering using open data and provides a reproducible benchmark for review-augmented public health systems
