Abstract:5G edge network slicing must reconcile two coupled requirements: understanding high-level operator intent and reallocating scarce computing and bandwidth resources under dynamic contention. Centralized optimization can face computational and responsiveness challenges under rapidly changing edge contention, and Multi-Agent System (MAS)-based auctions can support resource arbitration but still depend on operator-defined economic parameters and priorities. Embedding a Large Language Model (LLM) directly in a recurring control loop, by contrast, may introduce non-negligible inference latency and non-deterministic behavior. This paper proposes a two-timescale architecture that addresses this gap: an LLM-based Strategist translates natural-language network intents into economic policy parameters (budget, income, and bidding-aggressiveness) at the macro scale, while a deterministic, Vickrey-inspired second-price mechanism run by SPADE-based slice agents resolves recurring resource contention at the operational scale, with the resulting allocations enforced by patching Kubernetes CPU limits and Calico CNI bandwidth annotations directly on User Plane Function pods. We evaluate the architecture end-to-end on a real Kubernetes/Open5GS edge cluster across two complementary scenarios, each repeated 30 times: a Smart-City scenario, in which natural-language public-safety intents propagate into measurable changes in slice bids and bandwidth allocations within a few auction rounds, and a Hierarchical-slicing scenario, in which the mechanism provides priority-dependent resource and QoE differentiation, adapts to abrupt demand changes, and preserves configured minimum guarantees while maintaining near-complete allocation of the shared bandwidth pool.

Abstract:We present MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs), an easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), designed to be sample-efficient, computationally efficient, and researcher-centric. MARL benchmarks are typically simple and efficient, like SMAX, where winning reduces to unit micromanagement, or rich and costly, like Dota 2. MARL-BGs fills this missing middle. Its first mode, Team Deathmatch, is a simultaneous turn-based game between two teams of five heterogeneous agents. The five classes have distinct basic, passive, and ultimate abilities designed to synergize with allies and counter enemies. Our 52 hand-designed maps with diverse obstacles include a 12-map curriculum and ten held-out validation and test maps. MARL-BGs provides two canonical evaluation modes. First, eight endgame scenarios form a hard generalization challenge: each asks a team to win an unseen, nearly lost position against a strong reactive controller within 5-10 ticks. Second, a monthly round-robin tournament retrains each submission on equal compute, plays it against every member of the current “Big Nine” field, and publishes the Elo results on the official leaderboard. All entrants are publicly released as downloadable opponents. MARL-BGs records 11,192 metrics per game in 28 topics. We also include three strong scripted opponents, an analytical replay viewer, and off-the-shelf tools for self-play, cross-play, curriculum learning, and zero-shot coordination evaluation. We even provide an API for LLM-based agents and use it to evaluate Qwen3.5-9B against our strongest policy. In our BattleClient, humans can play alongside or against any mix of policies, enabling human-AI evaluation. We benchmark MARL-BGs with six additional deep MARL baselines, which we release. On one RTX 5090 with 1,024 parallel games, the simulator runs 50,000 5v5 game steps per second.

Abstract:LLM agents increasingly divide enterprise work across roles with different goals, authority, access, and information. Because each agent often sees only a local snapshot of the enterprise workflow, locally reasonable actions can still violate organization-wide constraints (e.g., several service agents can each issue credit that is individually permitted while collectively exceeding a shared compensation cap). We introduce EAIR, the first framework for analyzing enterprise multi-agent interaction risks. We make four contributions. (1) We formalize enterprise interaction risk in terms of the organizational properties that workflow operations must preserve, and operationalize this formulation as a taxonomy of testable risks with explicit failure criteria and evidence requirements. (2) We build EAIR-Worlds, a suite of executable micro-worlds that instantiates selected risks as controlled, observable workflows with explicit roles, policies, permissions, source facts, and execution traces. (3) We develop a novel diagnosis-and-repair pipeline that uses the resulting execution traces to locate contributing interaction boundaries, guide targeted workflow repairs, and retest the repaired system. (4) Large-scale experiments show recurring interaction failures across the organizational properties studied. Together, EAIR is the first operational framework for diagnosing and mitigating enterprise multi-agent interaction failures.

Abstract:Grassroots platforms are designed to be owned, operated and governed by their participants, and thus are constituted from person-to-person smartphone apps that run on participants’ smartphones. A grassroots app is specified using a grassroots social contract, which is compiled through an abstraction cascade into a volition-guarded Grassroots Logic Program (vGLP), a multiagent concurrent logic programming language. A vGLP program in turn specifies a smartphone UI via which people express their volitions and thus control the app. Prudence dictates large-scale evaluation and testing of grassroots platforms prior to deployment, but using the many people needed to do that is a contradiction in terms. Hence another solution is needed. Here, we present stochastic GLP (sGLP), designed to allow grassroots platforms to be simulated at scale from the vGLP programs that deploy them, with stochastic agents in place of people. sGLP is GLP with a rate extension for specifying stochastic behaviour. A stochastic agent is an sGLP program replacing both the vGLP UI and the person behind it. It is typed by the dual of the interactive type of the UI and specifies a stochastic profile of a person’s behaviour. We demonstrate sGLP on the grassroots social graph, with a population of men and women drawn from four stochastic profiles — homophile or indifferent, wary or sociable — and on grassroots currencies, with four profiles — spenders or savers, cautious or generous — and report what the mix of profiles does to the social graph that forms and to the currencies that circulate. We prove that every run of a vGLP program in which sGLP agents replace the UI and the people behind it is a vGLP run. We implemented sGLP in GLP by Gillespie’s method, and ran reproducible simulations with it. Abstract:Self-improving agents use failure feedback to revise their code or instructions, but gains after selection do not establish target-specific repair or generalization. We measure directedness by comparing repair of a randomly selected target failure with repair of the parent’s other failures. Across 145 eligible modifications in public Darwin Gödel Machine logs, we find no detectable target-specific advantage. Controlled instruction-revision experiments with small open models show that relevant feedback can improve target repair. In a second study with a pre-specified analysis plan, target feedback raised repair by 20 percentage points for Qwen3-4B relative to matched same-category feedback; the 7-point increase for Phi-4-mini was not significant. Target repair did not reliably imply held-out improvement. Held-out gains were concentrated in settings with identifiable, repairable failure mechanisms, including planted errors and natural tool-interface failures. Benefits of edit localization and regression screening varied across settings, while eight-step revision loops and GEPA ended at similar mean held-out accuracy. Evaluations should report target repair, transfer to related failures, and held-out net change separately.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）广告拍卖中因广告主价值存在高度相关性而引发的效率损失问题。在对话式助手场景下，多个广告主竞争同一赞助位，且均基于相同的用户对话内容进行出价，导致其出价意愿呈现显著正相关（affiliation），但现有拍卖机制将这些价值视为独立，从而未能有效捕捉这一经济特性，造成潜在收入损失。论文提出一种名为AffMyerson的新拍卖机制，其核心创新在于通过建模广告主价值为多元正态分布，并将经济上的正依赖关系（affiliation）转化为对精度矩阵（precision matrix）的符号约束条件，进而设计一种满足该约束的神经网络参数化结构。该设计确保了无论先验分布如何选择，拍卖始终是诚实（truthful）且事后个体理性（ex-post individually rational）的，估计误差仅影响收益而不破坏策略一致性。进一步地，该方法可闭式求解条件虚值（conditional virtual value），并通过巧妙的先验设计避免矩阵求逆，实现O(n²)时间复杂度的实时定价。研究还拓展至对数正态族，证明其在正确先验下为收益最优，且当条件方差低于宽松阈值时，虚值函数全局正则，符合实际应用需求。实验表明，在LLM代理投标者场景下，AffMyerson相比调优保留价的第二价格拍卖提升6.2%收益，优于Ronen的前瞻拍卖6.1%，并显著超越假设独立性的Myerson拍卖9.2%；即使在真实关键词搜索查询中，面对难以准确读取的支付意愿，仍能实现4.5%的收益增益。这一性能提升源于对共同需求驱动的相关性建模，尤其体现在基于对话语境联合出价的代理与仅执行计算任务的代理之间的行为差异上。

Abstract:Conversational assistants are becoming the place where people ask what to buy, and sponsored content is moving into their answers. Several advertisers then compete for one sponsored slot, and all of them read the same conversation, so their willingness to pay usually moves together. Existing auctions for LLM advertising treat these values as independent. We therefore present AffMyerson, an auction that captures this correlation and turns it into revenue. We model the advertisers’ values given the conversation as a multivariate normal and turn the economic premise of positive dependence (affiliation) into a sign condition on the precision matrix. We design a neural parameterization whose every output satisfies it. We prove that every prior in this family yields a truthful, ex-post individually rational auction, so estimation error can cost revenue but never truthfulness. We derive the conditional virtual values in closed form. By the design of the prior, pricing an auction needs no matrix inversion and takes O(n^2) time, fast enough to run at query time. We also work out the log-normal family used in empirical ad-auction work. There we prove that the auction is truthful for every prior and revenue-optimal when the prior is correct, and that the virtual value is regular everywhere whenever the conditional spread is below a loose threshold, which our fitted priors stay well under. With LLM-agent bidders, AffMyerson earns 6.2% more than a second-price auction with a tuned reserve, 6.1% more than Ronen’s lookahead auction with the same prior, and 9.2% more than Myerson’s auction run as if values were independent. This gain is still 4.5% on real keyword search queries where willingness to pay is hard to read. The correlation comes from common demand. Agents that judge the conversation bid together and agents told to calculate do not. The gain from conditioning moves with the correlation.

Abstract:As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.

Abstract:Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. Abstract:Long-horizon multi-agent collaboration requires memory that preserves both successful actions and the coordination structure underlying them. Existing memory systems support information sharing or procedural reuse, but often leave the evolution of shared procedures disconnected from the task dependencies and execution states of collaborating agents. This coupling also limits the direct transfer of procedural memory designed for individual agents to team settings. We propose Self-Evolving Procedural Memory (SEPM), a framework that uses task dependency graphs as a common representation for online coordination and procedural memory evolution. During execution, a lightweight shared blackboard records structured evidence alongside task dependencies, supporting the detection of goal, plan, and world-state divergence and evidence-based realignment. After execution, verified actions and dependencies are distilled into reusable procedures, while recurring failures inform warnings and constraints. The shared procedure pool evolves through creation, refinement, specialization, and retirement, guided by success and cost utility and constrained by evidence and safety requirements. Together, these mechanisms preserve the collaborative structure and applicability conditions needed to reuse experience across tasks. Evaluations on ALFWorld, WebArena, and OfficeBench under AutoGen and DyLAN show that SEPM achieves the highest task scores among the compared methods in all six benchmark settings. Under AutoGen, it improves task scores over the no-added-memory baseline by 29.85, 25.86, and 13.00 percentage points, respectively. The codebase is available at this https URL.

Abstract:Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-based MAS) have shown remarkable success in solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized agents through multi-step workflows. To overcome the high cost and specificity of manually designed workflows, recent research has shifted toward learning them automatically. However, a key limitation remains: while agent calls introduce significant latency due to model inference time and service congestion, most automated methods optimize solely for downstream performance, ignoring execution time (makespan). This issue is amplified when workflows are reused across recurring queries, making latency accumulate over time. This limits deployment in recurrent applications such as AI customer support and AI cloud troubleshooting, where users expect fast responses. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new problem, termed latency-aware workflow generation, where the objective is to minimize workflow makespan while aiming to retain downstream performance. We propose LAWA (Latency-Aware Workflow optimizAtion), a novel framework that reduces makespan via theoretically grounded graph edits targeting critical-path bottlenecks. By unifying a graph generator with this graph-editing procedure, LAWA supports both de novo workflow generation and refinement of existing ones. Empirical results across seven benchmarks demonstrate that LAWA significantly reduces makespan while achieving competitive task performance, supporting efficient reuse of multi-agent workflows for recurrent queries.

Abstract:Robustness tests for tool-using agents often change the agent’s environment, for example by hiding a hostile note in an invoice, and then judge the agent by what it does. The result tells us about the original task only if the changed test case is still a valid test of that task. Many evaluations decide this with weak rules, such as accepting any well-formed edit or any edit that stays close to the original in embedding space. We propose executable task contracts. A contract states which facts define a task, which edits are allowed, and what finishing the task means, and it checks each changed test case before the agent runs. We compare validity rules by scoring the same 14,336 stored agent runs under each rule. Across four encoders, embedding thresholds allowed 75-100% of edits that changed the task, such as swapping the payee, yet rejected 24-45% of valid hostile notes. With a MiniLM cosine threshold, Mistral appeared vulnerable on all 64 tasks, but only 26 had a successful valid attack. Replaying a saved solution and allowing edits to benchmark fields fail in similar ways. Evaluations should state, and check, what counts as the same task.

Abstract:Experiments with remote decision-making agents depend on more than the policy: the world may change during inference, the simulator determines which actions are available, and births and immigration alter who can act. We present Jevolution, an instrumented spatial predator-prey framework that makes these dependencies explicit. Its reference implementation separates the evolving world, asynchronous request scheduling, controller adapters, and experiment records. The model combines local observations, energy and resource constraints, predefined signals, and inherited scalar traits. We describe these mechanisms using the ODD protocol and distinguish implemented controls from research questions requiring additional interventions. Free synthetic fixtures exercise scheduling, signaling, and inheritance against the pinned implementation; they validate specified software behavior rather than model intelligence or ecological realism. A completed communication case study illustrates the end-to-end workflow using Jev to control both species. Across 6 complete habitat-seed pairs, the mean signals-on minus signals-off difference in normalized rabbit abundance was -0.0095 (nominal 95% pair-bootstrap interval [-0.0772, 0.0602]). This small study does not resolve the direction of the signal-system effect. The contribution is an inspectable experimental system and its evidence boundaries, not a new policy-learning algorithm or a demonstration of emergent language, adaptive selection, or biological predictive validity.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前生成式 AI (Generative AI) 系统在地理空间数据处理中面临的架构落地难题，即如何将高层级的治理性责任边界（如任务编排、空间验证、治理控制、可追溯性等）系统性地分解为可执行的低层级架构实现。其解决方案的关键在于采用设计科学研究（Design Science Research, DSR）方法，将 ANASSA 框架中的高层次架构（High-Level Architecture, HLA）责任映射为具体的低层级架构（Low-Level Architecture, LLA），构建出一套具备明确逻辑角色（共47个）、版本化任务图、基于能力的代理选择机制、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、故障处理与恢复路径以及可追溯性记录的可实施架构体系。该设计在保持原有责任边界的前提下，实现了对治理性空间智能工作流的可观测性、可重建性和可测试性，且不绑定特定的 AI 模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境，为未来系统的实现提供了技术无关的、可扩展的架构桥梁。

Abstract:Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

[MA-50] Akule: Fast and Scalable Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Sparse Interaction Diffusion

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模多机器人运动规划（Multi-Robot Motion Planning, MRMP）中基于扩散模型的轨迹先验在扩展至大规模机器人团队时面临的计算瓶颈问题，即如何在不进行昂贵联合计算的前提下，有效协调个体机器人的运动。其核心解决方案是提出一种稀疏交互扩散框架Akule，通过解耦“哪些交互值得计算”与“如何组合其影响”两个关键步骤，实现高效且可扩展的协同去噪更新。该方法引入三个可学习模块：一个可复用的成对修正模型 $ R_\phi $，一个上下文感知的选择器 $ U_\psi $ 用于决定评估哪些修正项，以及一个基于上下文的加权组合器 $ G_\omega ，以生成依赖上下文的带符号权重来融合修正效应。其中，，以生成依赖上下文的带符号权重来融合修正效应。其中，，以生成依赖上下文的带符号权重来融合修正效应。其中， R_\phi $ 通过匹配的成对轨迹优化进行训练，而 $ G_\omega $ 和 $ U_\psi $ 则从物理上优化的联合轨迹中学习，无需预设真实交互图。最终生成的联合提案由下游基于搜索的规划器验证与修复。实验表明，Akule在多种MRMP基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的规划成功率，最高可达25倍的完整规划加速，支持零样本群体迁移，并成功处理最多256个机器人的场景；消融实验证明，学习型选择与组合机制显著降低了修复前的冲突率及后续修复工作量，优于启发式选择与均匀叠加策略。

Abstract:Diffusion models provide expressive trajectory priors for multi-robot motion planning (MRMP), but scaling them to large teams requires coordinating individual motions without expensive joint computation. We introduce Akule, a sparse interaction diffusion framework that augments a frozen single-robot prior with three learned modules: a reusable pairwise correction model R_\phi , a contextual selector U_\psi that determines which corrections to evaluate, and a composer G_\omega that combines their effects through context-dependent signed weights. This decomposition separates which interactions merit computation from how their effects should be combined into coordinated denoising updates. We train R_\phi using matched pairwise trajectory optimizations, then learn G_\omega and U_\psi from physically optimized joint trajectories without requiring a prescribed ground-truth interaction graph. The resulting joint proposals are passed to a downstream search-based planner for validation and repair. Across diverse MRMP benchmarks, Akule achieves competitive planning success, complete-planner speedups of up to 25\times , zero-shot population transfer, and successful planning with up to 256 robots. Ablations further demonstrate that learned selection and composition reduce pre-repair conflicts and downstream repair effort relative to heuristic selection and uniform summation.

[MA-51] CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体协作训练中因任务求解轨迹缺乏有效反馈与修正机制而导致的“即时通过”或“重复失败但无纠正”的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在轨迹收集阶段主动引入可恢复的困难情境，以激发智能体间的检查、反馈与修复等协作行为，从而生成具有可解释性和指导意义的纠错数据。解决方案的关键在于提出CoEvoke框架，通过施加受控扰动（controlled perturbations）制造可恢复的挑战，并结合受限的基于参考的引导（restricted reference-based guidance）来约束探索方向，从而在不依赖私有参考或额外标注的前提下，构建出包含真实交互证据、决策链与任务原生结果的高质量重建轨迹数据集（共4,567条可重构轨迹，覆盖4,130个软件工程与推理任务）。实验表明，在相同训练任务、决策记录数量和更新次数条件下，引入扰动增强的评判器训练使ACPBench-Hard成功率从35.38%提升至42.12%（+6.73点），而SWE验证器训练相较未训练的接口匹配参考获得7.60–9.40点增益；同时，工作流与后训练评估在未扰动输入下仍能保持任务求解拓扑结构，证明了该方法在不改变求解代理（solving agents）的情况下，通过设计合理的轨迹采集条件即可获取有效的纠正性监督信号，显著提升协作决策质量。

Abstract:Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. Workflow and post-training evaluations preserve task-solving topology with unperturbed inputs and no private-reference guidance. These results support designing collection conditions to obtain corrective supervision that improves collaborative decisions with frozen solving agents.

[MA-52] LLM -Based Multi-Agent Collaboration for Constrained Multi-Objective Container Placement

【速读】：该论文旨在解决数据中心中容器部署（container placement）的复杂优化问题，核心挑战在于同时最小化能耗、最大化应用亲和性（affinity）偏好，并满足多资源容量与反亲和性（anti-affinity）等硬约束。传统方法依赖静态规则，缺乏对动态集群状态的适应能力且难以扩展；而元启发式方法虽具灵活性但计算开销大、收敛慢且易陷入局部最优。为此，本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体协作框架，其关键创新在于通过四类专用智能体在闭环ReAct循环中协同决策：能耗代理（Power Consumption Agent）与亲和性代理（Affinity Agent）就冲突目标进行辩论，部署代理（Placement Agent）采用容差门控仲裁（Tolerance-Gated Arbitration, TGA）实现冲突消解，重构代理（Rearrangement Agent）则在部署后阶段利用单调改进规则（Monotone Improvement Rule, MIR）进一步优化决策。所有智能体基于环境提供的确定性可行候选表进行推理，确保动作始终满足硬约束。实验基于Google集群日志数据，在100个应用与25台机器配置下，相比能耗优先基线，所提框架降低8.36%能耗并提升39.30%亲和性；消融实验表明，多轮辩论机制、TGA及MIR均对性能有显著贡献，任一组件移除均导致能耗与亲和性双重下降。

Abstract:Container placement in data centers must simultaneously minimize power consumption and maximize affinity preferences, while satisfying multi-resource capacity and anti-affinity constraints. Traditional approaches typically rely on fixed rules, which lack adaptability to dynamic cluster states and are difficult to extend for adaptive decision-making. On the other hand, meta-heuristic methods, although more flexible, are often computationally expensive, slower and prone to getting trapped in local optima. In this work, we propose an adaptive and efficient approach based on an LLM-driven multi-agent collaboration framework, where four specialized agents operate in a closed-loop ReAct cycle at each placement step. A Power Consumption Agent and an Affinity Agent debate over competing objectives, while a Placement Agent resolves conflicts using Tolerance-Gated Arbitration (TGA). A Rearrangement Agent further refines decisions through the Monotone Improvement Rule (MIR) in a post-placement refinement phase. All the agents reason over deterministic, feasibility-filtered candidate tables provided by the environment, ensuring that every proposed action inherently satisfies hard constraints. Based on experimental evaluation using the Google Cluster Trace with a configuration of 100 applications and 25 machines, the proposed framework consumes 8.36% less power and achieves 39.30% higher affinity than the power-greedy baseline. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component, the multi-round debate mechanism, the TGA in the Placement Agent, and the MIR in the Rearrangement Agent, contributes meaningfully to the overall performance, with removal of any single component degrading both power consumption and affinity satisfaction.

[MA-53] Collective Benefits and Efficiency in Coupled Echo State Networks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决集体智能中互动机制如何影响群体决策准确性和效率的问题，特别是探究在何种条件下成员间的交互能够超越独立响应的“群体智慧”并提升整体表现。其解决方案的关键在于引入基于回声状态网络（Echo State Network）的储层计算模型，通过耦合反馈机制模拟成员间的动态交互，揭示了交互过程中的协同效应。研究发现，采用池化反馈（pooled-feedback）进行交互的模型对能够重现巴赫拉米等人（Bahrami et al., 2010）报告的双人优势现象，而单纯的独立响应聚合则无法实现这一效果；进一步分析表明，交互有助于维持系统稳定性，避免输出因失控反馈（runaway feedback）而发散，从而提升准确性。此外，在效率方面，由较小规模但相互连接的模型组成的大群体，相较于少数大型独立模型，在同等总计算量下表现出更优性能。因此，该研究提出了一种形式化的理论框架，阐明了交互在特定条件下可增强集体智能的内在机制。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Simple aggregation of independent responses (“wisdom of crowds”) generally improves collective performance through statistical facilitation, but interaction among members can sometimes hinder group outcomes. However, under certain circumstances, coordination studies show that interacting groups can outperform their individual members and nominal groups, and interaction can also be more efficient than independence. We present a reservoir computing model to investigate how interaction can enhance joint performance in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Echo state networks were trained independently to identify Japanese speakers from vowel recordings and tested jointly with and without coupled feedback. Model pairs reproduced the dyadic advantage reported by Bahrami et al. (2010) with interaction via pooled-feedback, but not when independent responses were aggregated together. Model dynamics revealed that interaction was beneficial whereas aggregated outputs were prone to diverging from runaway feedback over time. In terms of efficiency, larger groups of smaller interacting models outperformed smaller groups of larger models while equating for total amount of group computation. Our results offer a formal framework for explaining when and why interaction enhances collective intelligence.

[NLP-0] ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agent ic Robotics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决代理型机器人（agentic robotics）中因大语言模型（LLM）频繁推理导致的效率瓶颈问题。在现有框架下，每个动作原语（primitive）都需要调用一次完整的LLM推理以回顾全部交互历史，使得任务执行成本随原语数量线性增长，严重制约了实际应用中的实时性与可扩展性。其核心解决方案是提出分块执行（ChunkAct）机制，关键在于将记忆中已知的动作序列预先编译为“动作块”（action chunk），在线执行时仅需一次LLM调用即可触发一整串链式原语的自主执行，直至失败才返回控制权。该方法实现了运行时内存免依赖，并将LLM计算资源集中于真正需要决策的高层选择，而非重复的底层动作规划。因此，LLM的计算复杂度由原语数量降为决策次数，显著提升效率。在LIBERO-Pro基准上，ChunkAct相较当前最优方案提升了5.0个任务成功率，同时减少2.9倍的LLM调用、4.4倍输入token及2.3倍输出token，充分验证了其高效性与实用性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.

[NLP-1] v: Scaling Long-Horizon Agent ic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决开源生成式智能体在长时程任务（long-horizon tasks）上表现不佳的核心问题，其根本挑战在于缺乏高质量的训练数据与可扩展的训练方法：长而复杂的任务难以有效构建、验证，且奖励信号稀疏，导致模型难以学习。为此，论文提出两个关键创新：一是构建首个具备可验证性、密集且渐进式奖励的长时程智能体训练数据集Tev-Gym，涵盖7个领域共1,170个经验证的任务环境，采用“隐世界优先”（latent-world-first）方法，先构建任务领域的完整隐藏规范（包括工作流与每一步后的预期状态），再逐步渲染为智能体可感知的环境，从而实现复杂度可控与自然进度度量；二是提出进度潜力奖励塑造（Progress-Potential Reward Shaping, PPRS）策略，将进度指标转化为每步密集奖励，显著提升训练效率并使原本不可训练的任务变为可训练。基于此方案训练出的Tev-27B模型在Agents’ Last Exam（ALE-CM）计算与数理科学领域达到与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5相当的性能（Pass@5），且仅使用ALE相关数据即展现出对Terminal-Bench 3.0/4.0的强泛化能力，超越GLM 5.2与Gemini 3.7 Flash，同时在中等时程任务（如TB 2.1）上达到接近Claude Opus 4.8的水平。

Abstract:Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously – from hours to days – on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards – 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents’ Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.

[NLP-2] DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 在推理过程中因长思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）导致的冗余计算与高显存消耗问题，即模型在求解任务时产生过长且不必要的推理路径，从而增加推理成本。现有方法如基于训练的压缩、添加固定控制向量或采用启发式截断策略虽可缩短思维链，但普遍存在需额外训练、影响准确率或破坏推理逻辑等缺陷。本文提出一种无需训练的解码方法 DoubtLess，其核心创新在于利用一个小型推理模型对大型模型进行引导：该小模型分别以“简洁”和“冗长”两种角色评估大模型当前的思维链，并将两者输出的对数概率向量之差（按强度缩放后）动态注入大模型的每一步解码过程，从而激励其生成更紧凑的推理路径。实验表明，在七项涵盖竞赛数学、研究生级科学及编程竞赛的基准测试中，DoubtLess 使 Qwen3-32B 的思维链长度平均缩短 31% 且保持原有准确率；在自调试编码代理中，每轮思考令牌数减少 20% 而任务性能不变。此外，该方法具有良好的泛化能力，适用于其他模型架构，并可与训练驱动的压缩技术协同进一步提升效率。消融分析显示，其主要节省来自正确答案首次出现后的重复验证行为，有效提升了推理效率。

作者: Minghao Luo,Liang Chen
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong(香港中文大学); EPFL(洛桑联邦理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model’s hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like “wait”, which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model’s CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model’s logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-3] Hybrid Reasoning Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）智能体在推理与外部环境交互中难以兼顾高效内部思维与可解释性动作表达的矛盾问题。现有方法要么依赖文本进行全程推理（缺乏效率），要么采用隐式表示（如潜在空间）进行推理但丧失了对工具调用的原生支持和推理过程的透明性。其核心解决方案是提出混合推理智能体（Hybrid Reasoning Agents, HybridAgents），通过动态切换“潜在推理”与“文本交互”两种模式，在统一生成流程中实现二者无缝衔接。关键设计包括：1）轻量级混合链接（HybridLink），实现文本与潜在表示间的平滑转换；2）持续工作记忆机制，确保多轮交互中混合上下文无损保留。在此架构基础上，进一步引入专用后训练算法：HybridSFT 用于协调主干模型与 HybridLink 的协同行为，提升工具集成能力；HybridRL 则通过强化学习优化决策策略，明确何时使用潜在空间思考、何时以文本形式执行动作。实验表明，HybridAgent 在11个涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索及自主推理的基准上，相较于前沿文本或潜在空间方法，平均性能提升10.4%，同时实现35.5%–54.7%的令牌消耗减少、1.8x–2.6x加速推理速度，并带来2.7x–3.7x的成本降低。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent’s continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-4] he Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决地球观测（Earth Observation, EO）模型依赖人工设计与调优的瓶颈问题，即当前EO任务仍需专家手动构建训练方案并基于基准数据进行反复调整，这一过程耗时且难以泛化。其核心解决方案是将模型构建流程自动化，引入一个通用编程代理（coding agent），通过定义“测试框架”（harness）和“验证器”（verifier）两个关键组件，使代理能够自主完成模型构建与迭代优化。其中，“测试框架”限定代理可用的资源与操作空间，“验证器”则明确成功标准，可通过标注基准、独立传感器数据、物理模型或同一区域的重复观测实现可验证性。在此机制下，代理可在仅使用少量标签（约1%）的情况下，在光学、合成孔径雷达（SAR）及多光谱时序影像等四类典型EO任务上超越现有技术水平，并持续提升性能。该方法将原本割裂的研究方向（如小样本学习、跨域适应等）统一为“测试框架”与“验证器”的配置选择，确立了以人类设计目标、代理自主建模为核心的新型地球观测范式，推动EO模型随代理能力进化而持续演进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18845
作者: Sijie Zhao,Zeqi Zhou,Heli Qi,Xuanchao Fu,Zhuo Zheng,Junshi Xia,Junjue Wang,Weihao Xuan,Naoto Yokoya
机构: The University of Tokyo (东京大学); RIKEN (理化学研究所); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Yokoya-Lab-UTokyo/RSI4EO
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Ongoing project

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.

[NLP-5] OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在视频理解能力评估中缺乏全面性与系统性的问题。现有基准测试仅覆盖部分评估维度，难以实现对全模态视频理解能力的深入诊断。为此，论文提出OmniCompass——一个面向全模态视频定位与理解的综合性评估基准。其核心解决方案在于构建双轨评估体系：OmniCompass-VL针对视觉-语言模型，评估需依赖视觉证据的任务；OmniCompass-AV则面向全模态模型，评估需联合音视频证据的任务。每条赛道均包含时序定位（Temporal Grounding, TG）、空间定位（Spatial Grounding, SG）和问答（Question Answering, QA）三类互补任务，分别考察目标出现的时间、位置及事件内容。QA任务进一步细分为感知与推理两类，其中OmniCompass-VL涵盖5种感知和3种推理类别，OmniCompass-AV包含3种感知和2种推理类别。数据集共包含820段视频（短、中、长三种时长）及2,460个实例，其中音频丰富且叙事性强的子集构成OmniCompass-AV，含240段视频与720个实例。所有实例均采用文本仅输入与文本+图像双条件设置进行评估，以检验模型在不同引导方式下的表现一致性。所有标注均经多轮人工质量验证。对50个MLLMs的评估结果表明，开源模型在整体性能上仍显著落后于闭源模型，尤其是在音视频联合理解方面；即便领先模型在时序与空间定位任务中仍存在显著挑战，且在不同提示条件下预测结果存在不一致现象。

Abstract:With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

[NLP-6] Read the Room Before Your Model Generates AACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成文本时，采样温度（sampling temperature）设置缺乏情境可解释性的问题。现有方法多依赖固定或启发式全局设定，或基于上下文/词元级别的校准，难以体现对话场景的几何可解释结构。为此，本文提出一种简洁且可解释的温度选择框架——Scenario-Actor，其核心在于通过从Transformer隐藏状态中提取与场景相关的结构信息，构建场景嵌入（scenario embedding），即对交际情境的结构化几何表征，并据此动态确定采样温度。该方案的关键在于将温度调节过程与对沟通场景的语义-几何理解相结合，使解码策略能够自适应地反映情境特征。实验结果表明，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上，Scenario-Actor在交互式社交场景中实现了优异的目标完成率，在开放式指令遵循任务中取得显著提升，并在多轮对话任务中表现与多个基线相当。

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbfScenario-Actor, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.

[NLP-7] Back-Translation Still Matters: Leverag ing Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言机器翻译中因平行语料稀缺而导致性能受限的问题，尤其关注在仅有少量平行数据（如1K对）但存在中等规模单语数据的情况下，如何更有效地利用这些额外资源以提升翻译质量。其核心挑战在于：传统方法如持续预训练（continued pretraining）对低资源语言的增益有限，而直接使用少量平行数据进行微调又难以充分挖掘模型潜力。解决方案的关键在于引入源自预大语言模型（LLM）时代的回译（back-translation, BT）技术——即利用可获得的单语数据，通过已微调的模型生成目标语言的伪平行句对，再以此反向训练模型，从而实现对源语言到目标语言翻译能力的增强。该方法通过在平行数据上交替更新，确保学习过程稳定；同时结合从真实平行数据中检索的上下文示例进一步优化结果。实验表明，在奥迪亚语和斯瓦希里语上，该方法比持续预训练提升7.7至16.4个XCOMET-XXL分数，在部分情况下甚至超越使用十倍更多平行数据的模型。跨五种低资源语言的评估显示，相较于仅依赖平行数据微调，回译使翻译性能提升16%至173%（以XCOMET-XXL衡量），且人工盲评结果与自动指标一致，验证了其有效性。

Abstract:Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.

[NLP-8] Self-Evolving Agent Harness

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）系统在长期运行中因环境变化、任务演化及评估标准迭代而导致的可靠性下降问题，核心挑战在于如何在不更新模型权重的前提下，实现智能体（agent）软件架构（包括提示词、记忆机制、工作流与可执行组件）的持续自进化。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于反馈驱动的自进化框架——Harness RSI（Harness Self-Evolution），通过将更新目标与提议、接纳机制分离，明确区分对解释状态的修改与对工具、代码、仓库级控制逻辑及插件组合的重构。该框架采用进化优化策略进行搜索，并借助持续 PAC 学习（continual PAC-learning）分析其可靠性，建立了在特定假设下的期望泛化界、依赖历史回溯预算的保留界，以及基于独立验证数据的高概率接纳规则。此外，研究强调了持久性架构修订对知识共享与组织工作流的影响，并指出可靠部署需伴随任务分布和评估者动态变化的持续验证机制，同时对学习过程、运行时权限和关键操作设置独立保障。

Abstract:Harness self-evolution revises an agent’s software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model–harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at this https URL.

[NLP-9] SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agent ic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式智能体在强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）中因技能注入（skill injection）的盲目性与评估成本高昂所导致的效率低下和性能不稳定问题。现有方法通常假设技能注入必然有益，或依赖高开销的滚动（rollout）评估来间接判断技能效用，而这种评估在采样有限时既不经济也不稳定。针对此问题，论文提出一种自适应策略训练框架SkillScaffold，其核心创新在于通过重用已验证结果的训练轨迹，基于结果感知的似然比较实现低成本、高稳定的技能效用估计，避免了对每个候选技能进行独立环境滚动的开销。该效用估计结果指导是否以及选择何种技能进行注入，在无有效技能时则保持无技能执行，从而实现动态决策。同时，生成器与执行器联合训练机制使生成的技能能随策略演进而自适应优化，促进技能内化以支持无技能推理。实验在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld及τ²-Bench等多个基准上验证了该方法在短/长序列任务中的优越性，消融研究进一步证明了基于效用的选择与主动放弃策略的重要性。

Abstract:Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy’s competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and \tau^2 -Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-10] SEAR: Self-Evolving Agent ic Robotics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前前沿语言模型驱动的机器人智能体在自主学习与能力迁移方面存在的核心问题：如何区分智能体是否真正实现了持续性学习，而非仅通过大量试错来偶然成功；以及其习得的能力是否具备跨任务、跨仿真环境乃至真实机器人平台的泛化能力。其解决方案的关键在于提出SEAR（Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics）框架与基准测试体系，通过三种运行模式实现对智能体行为的系统性评估——即“代码即策略”（code-as-policy）、“智能体即策略”（agent-as-policy）和“自动研究者”（auto-research）模式，分别对应代码生成、实时控制与视觉-语言-动作模型的自适应微调。同时，基准测试引入多重控制变量，有效分离了经验留存与重复尝试、任务熟悉度、模拟器状态特权、预算规模及运气等干扰因素。实验结果表明：1）智能体的学习效率受总时间预算与任务难度相对于模型能力的相对关系影响显著；2）通用控制代码与共享函数具有良好的跨任务与跨仿真迁移能力，而任务特异性解法则不具备泛化性；3）不同语言模型在不同演化路径上表现各异，部分模型更依赖实时行动，另一些则更适合先生成代码；此外，纯文本模型的表现可媲美多模态模型，凸显了代理式推理与工具使用的重要性，而非单纯依赖感知能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18792
作者: Xinyi Wang,Bangzheng Li,Hanyu Wang,Lin Zhang,Andrea Yaoyun Cui,Zhenggang Tang,Shyamal Buch,Dejia Xu
机构: Luma AI
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 16 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

[NLP-11] Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value Diversity and Aggregation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）集成方法中评估增益时因基准对照选择不同而导致结果偏差的问题。现有研究通常以单一基线作为参照来衡量集成带来的性能提升，但这种评估方式忽略了不同对照条件对增益归因的影响。论文通过在四种匹配条件下对比分析：直接输入（Direct）、单槽位（Single-slot）、重复候选（Duplicate）与多候选（Multi-candidate），揭示了整体候选增益（Candidate Improvement Value, CIV）可代数分解为额外候选对比（Divergence from Single-Variant, DSV）和候选-上下文对比（Candidate-Context Variance, CCV）两部分；其中，尽管CIV整体值不变，但其分解结构依赖于所选控制条件。在多跳检索增强生成（MultiHopRAG, k=2）任务中，重复间隙（Repetition Gap, Rep）达-8.33个百分点（95% CI: [-13.25, -3.75]），表明以重复候选为基准时测得的增益显著低于以单候选为基准的结果。在更强面板扩展的FRAMES实验中（n=200, k=3, 输出限制4096），配对差值ΔRep为+9.67个百分点（[+6.00, +13.50]），且在面板内重复间隙符号反转（原为-6.33，强面板下变为+3.33），进一步凸显控制条件对增益解释的关键影响。研究发现，在证据聚合场景中，无论采用何种非多样性控制，候选-上下文对比始终呈强烈负向。因此，论文强调：在进行LLM集成评估时，必须明确定义参考控制条件，否则对额外候选贡献的归因将不可靠。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18786
作者: Donghwan Kim
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 14 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.

[NLP-12] Pack Light CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长时序智能体（long-horizon agents）在持续任务中因反复处理交互历史而导致的计算冗余问题。现有方法通常依赖压缩后的历史记录或对进展的重构来维持上下文连续性，但这种方式效率低下且难以扩展。其核心挑战在于：如何在保留任务进展可复用性的前提下，避免因历史状态被丢弃而重新构建完整上下文表示。为此，论文提出 CarryOn，一种面向对象的上下文运行时机制，将延续性（continuation）组织于可复用的任务对象（task objects）之上，而非依赖历史轨迹本身。其关键创新在于引入“承载者”（carrier）记录机制，通过维护跨执行轮次的载体状态，在任务状态折叠（fold）后仅对受影响的记录基于绑定证据与环境约束进行增量更新，同时保留未受影响的记录并协同更新执行上下文。该方法显著提升了上下文管理效率，实验表明在 OSWorld 2.0 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别实现 5.8% 和 7.0% 的性能提升，同时分别减少 51.9% 和 22.9% 的总令牌消耗。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18784
作者: Yuchen Lu,Julian McAuley,Lei Zhang
机构: University of California San Diego(加州大学圣地亚哥分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: this https URL

[NLP-13] BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大型语言模型多智能体系统（Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems）在协作过程中失败诊断困难的问题。由于各智能体间存在角色、工具与工作流的分工协作，单一智能体对正确结果的误判可能导致错误被后续智能体持续传播，从而难以定位根本原因。现有方法虽能追踪信息依赖关系，但仅知信息来源并不等同于识别其使用过程中的偏差。为此，论文提出无需训练的BLADE（Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence）框架，其核心在于超越单纯的信息溯源，转而对信息使用过程进行审计。该框架基于结构化概率判断（Jev）机制，利用依赖概率筛选关键源-决策交接点，并在这些节点上检验接收方是否忠实且符合任务要求地使用了输入信息，进而区分错误引入、传播与修复三类行为。最终通过全局视角整合所有执行步骤的审计结果，实现精准的责任归属。实验表明，在无参考答案条件下，BLADE在五个WhoWhen及WhoWhen Pro子集共1,228次失败运行中，相较于八种策略均达到最优或并列最优的步骤级准确率，显著优于All-at-once方法2.2–11.1个百分点。显式呈现责任证据为构建更具可解释性与可靠性的智能体系统提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18780
作者: Xiaoguang Guo,Yaohao Long,Chuxu Zhang
机构: University of Connecticut (康涅狄格大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 16 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents’ capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five WhoWhen and WhoWhen Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.

[NLP-14] Rubrics from the Task Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有基于评分量表的奖励模型（Rubric-based Reward Models, RMs）中存在的响应诱导偏差（response-induced bias）问题，以及人工评判者在仅依赖阅读时难以应对机械性约束、且常用成对评判仅提供相对偏好而难以直接用于策略优化的局限性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种点对点式（pointwise）的评分量表奖励模型ReVeR，该模型通过仅基于指令本身进行推理来生成硬性规则与分级原则，并借助工具增强的评判机制独立评估响应。两个核心组件均通过标签无偏蒸馏（label-blind distillation）训练，其中偏好标签仅用于筛选教师模型的输出，从而构建出大规模的“评分量表推理与评判轨迹”数据集ReVeR-Traces。实验表明，ReVeR在平均偏好准确率、测试时缩放能力及下游策略优化方面均优于成对式评分量表奖励模型，尤其在指令遵循任务上表现显著；同时研究揭示了偏好准确率、评分量表保真度与下游效用是相互独立的属性，为未来奖励模型研究提供了重要启示。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18766
作者: Tianci Liu,Haoyu Wang
机构: University of Tennessee(田纳西大学); University at Albany(阿尔巴尼大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher’s outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.

[NLP-15] Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports AACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自动危机报告评估中“评估标准应基于实践者真实需求，而非仅便于比较”的核心问题。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个由专业人道主义情境报告通过定性内容分析提炼出的15个信息槽（information schema），并采用大语言模型（LLM）辅助、作者审定的内容分析方法，对121份人工撰写和261份LLM生成的报告在五个灾害事件及三种灾害类型下进行系统评估。研究发现，在气旋伊代（Cyclone Idai）场景中，谷歌Gemini-3.7-flash生成的报告虽名义上略超人类报告表现（0.827 vs. 0.821），但差异在统计上不显著（95%置信区间[-0.049, 0.059]；置换检验p=0.852），且该结果在OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna模型下无法复现。盲评结果显示作者与Gemini判别器一致性达0.910准确率和0.799的无加权Cohen’s κ，四名裁判均满足原始一致性阈值0.7，唯独Gemini在调整随机一致性的κ值上达标。跨三大主事件分析表明，机器报告仅能再现5.4%-11.0%的当日官方数据，而精确数值匹配中，官方数据与社交流关联率为14.3%-19.6%，机器报告则高达85.4%-90.1%；人工审计确认45/50的缺失声明正确，仅4/25官方匹配与24/25机器匹配具有语义一致性。此外，所有12个事件-裁判组合均存在“发布来源缺口”（issuing-provenance gap），即报告日期、组织、系列与权威信息在专业报告中完全缺失。最终，传统指标如ROUGE-L无效，BERTScore在多重校正后与完整性呈负相关，通用LLM判别器甚至出现方向反转，凸显现有评估范式局限性。

机构: LexisNexis(雷克斯尼斯)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)

Abstract:Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95% bootstrap CI [-.049,.059] ; permutation p=.852 ), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen’s \kappa=.799 . All four judges clear the plan’s raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected \kappa . Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.

[NLP-16] PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于单元测试（unit test）的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）在代码生成模型后训练阶段中存在的根本性缺陷：仅依赖通过/失败的二元奖励信号会导致模型倾向于过度修改代码并产生虚假错误（即“幻觉”错误），从而降低代码修复的精确性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为PreciseCoder的新训练算法，该算法通过引入语义验证且局部化的编辑信号（semantically verified, localized edits）来增强原有的单元测试奖励，从而引导模型关注更小、更精准的代码修改。实验表明，在4B、9B和27B规模的模型上，PreciseCoder可将平均编辑行数从7–15行显著降低至3行，同时保持与纯单元测试训练相当的通过率；此外，该方法在单行错误修复训练下具备良好的泛化能力，适用于仓库级程序修复，并能通过推理轨迹（reasoning trace）实现跨模型精度迁移——即使未经过额外训练，前沿大模型如GPT-5.6 Sol和Qwen3.8-Max也能获得4.6–12.4分的编辑精度提升。语言学分析进一步揭示，该奖励机制促使模型聚焦于逐行推理、准确识别问题代码行并形成一致的错误假设，从而显著提升了修复过程的可解释性与准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18755
作者: Yunkai Zhan,Miaosen Chai,Shangshang Wang,Jike Zhong,Yuqing Yang,Deqing Fu,Serina Chang,Wang Bill Zhu
机构: University of Chicago (芝加哥大学); University of Southern California (南加州大学); Google(谷歌); University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.

[NLP-17] On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在安全监控中缺乏可解释性与可信监督机制的问题，具体聚焦于如何通过自然语言自编码器（Natural Language Autoencoders, NLAs）实现对模型内部激活向量的可理解性监督。其核心挑战在于：人类监督者能否仅依据激活向量的自然语言解释（由激活表述器，Activation Verbaliser, AV生成）准确区分真实描述与精心构造的虚假描述。论文的关键创新在于将NLA的训练与监督部署分别建模为两种不同类型的涌现通信（Emergent Communication）中的参照游戏：训练阶段为生成式参照游戏，强调从向量生成合理解释；而监督阶段则为判别式、多模态、部分可观测的参照游戏，涉及激活向量与对应陈述之间的多对多关系，且要求区分真实与近似虚假的解释。理论分析指出，由于训练过程未强制要求解释排除错误选项，导致AV生成的解释虽能识别其所描述的激活，却难以有效区分与其高度相似的虚假解释。通过引入自编码器自身重构器（AR）作为最友好的代理监督模型进行实验验证，在一个公开检查点上发现，真实解释在全部320次比较中均优于其他激活的解释，但在面对仅在一个主张上存在差异的流畅竞争解释时，仅在60.2%的情况下胜出（显著高于随机水平50%，但远低于理想表现），且经独立模型进行语义保持重写后，虚假解释与真实解释间的距离仅增加2.1%，表明失败并非源于解释中存在私有约定。该结果限定于对话层面的事实正确性，未触及模型内部处理机制的真实性，因此论文进一步提出假设，认为上述现象可被该框架统一解释。
